title: Madrid Tapas and Wine Tasting Tour
description: Explore Madrid's culture through its tapas and wine on this guided tour, limited to a small group of 12 people for an intimate atmosphere. Exploring alongside a guide allows you to discover Spanish specialties you may never have heard of, such as chickpea stew, salted cod, and obscure local ingredients. Unlike some other tapas tours, all food samples and wine are included. Choose from a lunch or dinner departure time for added flexibility.

reviews.usertext: We did the tapas and wine tasting on the Friday over the Easter bank holiday weekend so it was very busy, but this wasn’t a problem. You get taken to four different places to enjoy food and drink at both, you can choose what drinks you have at each bar, red wine, white wine or a couple of other options. The places we visited were all very nice and all quite different, I won’t say too much but it was a mix of fish, meat, cheese, bread and other mixed dishes. The tour is very much a social event, you get to meet other people from around the world and all the people on our tour were very nice. Our guide for the tour, Carlos, was excellent, really chatty, engaging, full of knowledge and friendly, he made sure the tour enjoyable for everyone and kept the conversation flowing. We thoroughly enjoyed the night and ended up staying in the last venue with four other members of the tour until they closed, we were literally the last to leave. This tour is great value for money given the knowledge of the guide and food and drink you get and a fantastic way to meet people and explore different venues in Madrid.

The best! Highly recommended - of course, apart from an awesome guide (Paola), it also depends on the people within the group. We lucked out with a nice mix from Canada, Australia, Wales and the U.S. Various ages and lots of fun mixing - particularly after the first tapa bar. We are cheapskates but this was totally worth the money. Enough tapas that everyone was full by the end AND a nice variety of beverages and tapas to try out. Our guide, Paola, provided more information than the minimum about the various plazas and bars we visited. It was great that a group of local college students happened in on one of the bars and provided a show. We are experienced travelers and bilingual/bicultural and enjoyed this thoroughly, as did the other members of our group. Enjoy and Salud!

Our guide Ismail was great company and highly knowledgeable about his city and it’s history as well as our tapas and accompanying wines. He created a convivial atmosphere amongst our group. We had a lovely time. Would highly recommend!

A worthwhile way of getting peek into the historical city, it's narrow lanes (filled with history) and the most important of getting chance to enjoy various tapas (small entree food servings). This is an worthwhile trip with well knowledgeable guides (Ismail) and a chance to interact with other tourists (each group will be of 12-15 people ) . They take through various restaurants and guiding us on their best food and drinks to try. The trip runs around 3.5 hours

The tour guide Carlos was really very good . He gave us a very good insight about wine regions , types of wines and tapas from all over Spain . He also gave us a lot of historical facts about Madrid and the surrounding area of city centre that we walked around with him . The tapas dishes in all the establishments, were fantastic . Real value for money and very enjoyable. I 100% recommend this tour when visiting Madrid.

I’ve been coming to Madrid for years, and did not think I would learn much from this tour as I feel I know a lot of bars and restaurants in the area. At the Ribera del Duero tour (highly recommended), one of the guests recommended this tapas and wine tour and I thought, why not? I’m so glad I took the tour, because not only did I discover new venues that I had not been to before, but learned a lot about wine and good, and also passed a very enjoyable evening.
I met the guide, Carlos, at the Plaza Santa Ana by the bronze statue of Lorca. We were joined by another participant. A third was running late but we arranged to meet him at the first venue.
The first stop was El Fontan, an Asturian restaurant tgst I’ve walked by dozens of times but never thought of stopping in (mistake!). We had a lovely Mencia wine and some dry cider poured up high. I was not expecting such a delicious and bountiful spread of food, but we were served eggplant with honey, 2 types of croquetas, and a strong cabrales cheese.
The second stop was a stealthy venue I would never have discovered otherwise. La Venencia is a sherry bar that has been around since the 1920’s! Hemingway was a fan. We were escorted down into the cave and were served a beautiful manzanilla and more food- aged Manchego cheese, cecina, mojama as well as olives and marcona almonds, all perfect with the wine.
The third place is one I’m well-familiar with as I’ve been going there for years, La Casa del Abuelo. We went to the original one (they’ve expanded and now have 5 restaurants). The restaurant is family-owned and they serve their own proprietary wine. We were served a bubbling dish of gambas al ajillo and patata bravas with our wine.
The fourth and last stop was to a place that I would never have thought about going to, as I generally avoid places frequented by so many tourists. Los Galayos is a restaurant in Plaza Mayor. We sat inside and prior to this visit I had no idea if how lovely it was. We had cava along with more divine food: squid with eggs, tortilla de patata (Carlos said it was second only to his mother’s!), Torreznos (deep fried pork belly) and gif dessert, torrijas, a sort of French toast with turron ice cream.
What else can I say? It was a wonderful experience, well worth the price.
I must mention that our guide Carlos was extremely professional, patient and personable.
I cannot recommend this tour highly enough.

Paula was an excellent guide. She gave us some history of each restaurant stop, information about the Spanish wines, and history of beautiful Madrid. I would highly recommend this tour! Lots of delicious food and wine, and it’s fun meeting travelers from other parts of the world.

This was an excellent tour of the city center with history, culture, and humor woven together to give you an authentic local experience of tapas and drinks. Our guide Ishmael, was knowledgeable and kind. He answered all of of our questions and even gave us recommendations for our next night. I’d highly recommend this tour.

What an amazing night of eating, drinking, learning history and meeting lovely people with Natalia, our fantastic tour guide. Can’t say enough about this tour. If you come to Madrid would be better to do this FIRST! You really get to learn about the local foods and wines and visit local restaurants. We had a different type of wine in each restaurant. They were mostly old restaurants which had been running for about 100 years each! We learned about the history of each of the restaurants and different landmarks of Madrid. Also learned so much about the history of Madrid and it makes your visit just so much more interesting. Natalia also gave us extra tips on what to do in our free time in Madrid the following day, and we loved some of the places she recomended visiting - we did not know about some of them. She was so knowledgable, fun, and just a great time! Highly recommend this.

This was an excellent tour for a tapas beginner and someone not familiar with wines. We went to four tapas establishments spread across a nice but not too far area. Good and refreshing walks in between each place. We sampled different styles of tapas while Carlos, our guide gave a nice presentation of the wine. We enjoyed two or three dishes at each stop and were able to select a white or red wine. We were a group of eleven which was perfect to have great conversation with each at the different stops and along the walks in between. The timing was perfect and we never felt rushed. It was a thoroughly enjoyable evening.

Manfred, our guide was wonderful and engaged everyone on our group of mostly 10 strangers to the point we knew each other at the end. We went to 4 different local tapas places, each very different. He explained why he chose them what he recommended to drink at each and why. Manfred also explained the differences and origins of different styles of tapas.

Great evening!

Ishmael was a fabulous tour guide through Madrid. We enjoyed the 4 Bar/Tapas places we stopped at and the group size was perfect. Ishmael did a fantastic job picking Tapas and Wine that the whole group would enjoy. I highly recommend this tour to anyone who likes wine and want to enjoy the food of the local Spaniards. Thanks Ishmael great job!!!!

The tour was very good. The guide was very knowledgeable and energetic. We sampled a full glass of wine at each stop, 4 total. Each restaurant/bar had unique tapas. Overall, the experience was very good! However, after walking into other restaurants/bars in Madrid, I do feel the tour is a bit expensive. An average glass of wine is about 2.5 - 4.5€. The tapas are traditionally served/included with any drink order. While we enjoyed the tour, I don’t know that I would necessarily recommend it to friends/family due to the cost.

My wife and I loved this tour and Paula made it so much better. Madrid is such an interesting and historical city; the tapas and wine tour only makes it better. My wife and I spent 3 days Madrid and visited some of the bars/Restaurants after this tour because the food and wine were so great. We would highly recommend this tour with Paula. Doing this tour with people visiting from other countries is an added benefit.

Noemi our tour guide met 9 of us at the Lorca statue and took us to our first stop where we had garlic prawns and excellent red wine (beer for non wine drinkers) and some crusty bread to dip… alternatives were available for those who don’t wish to have prawns. Noemi was knowledgeable about the food venues and wine but after a few drinks and enjoying each others company I think she may have lost our group a little as we were having such a good time together and getting to know one another! The other venues were equally good and I have to say the red wine in particular was of excellent quality. We got to experience a variety of food and even dessert at the end! Lots of food and great company, can highly recommend this tour.

Good food and wine at the 4 tapas bars we visited but needed a smaller group and a more dynamic tour guide. The guide was very soft spoken and gave us only basic info about the bars and food we were eating. There were also 10 of us on the tour which was too many for small restaurants and for hearing what he had to say. On a positive note, he knew his wines and picked some good ones.

This was a great experience for my family! Paula was friendly and so knowledgeable about the varieties of wine as well as the restaurants she took us to. It was so enjoyable to go to restaurants where the madrileños go and not the ones that are geared towards tourists. The tapas we were able to try were different at each restaurant but equally delicious. Additionally, she was very well-spoken in English which is a benefit for travelers who want to do an authentic tour but do not speak Spanish. I would absolutely recommend this to others.

I really enjoyed the evening spent eating tapas and drinking wine under the expert guidance of Carlos. He brought us into places that it was very obvious only locals go. I would never have found these places on my own. The tapas was excellent in each and we got to drink fine reds, whites and even a special vermouth. Carlos knew what he was doing and he made a great effort to ensure we got a real feel for Madrid's tapas life. I highly recommend that you do this evening.

Paula divina! We had such a great time with diverse group who after tour continued to other bars. She was so knowledgeable and accomodating, even to 1 guest who was not so happy. Great tour, highly recommend and ask fir Paula!!! Great wine and tapas too.

What a fantastic few hours spent around some of the wonderful Tapas bars we wouldn’t have discovered ourselves. Carlos was very friendly and spoke excellent English. His enthusiasm for the food and wine we enjoyed was clear to see as he described each dish and origin of the 4 wines we tried in each of the 4 tapas bars and restaurants we visited, a fantastic way to get acquainted with some places where the locals go to eat and drink. Carlos was a fantastic host, highly recommended!

We really enjoyed Naomi, our guide and the delicious tapas. All four places had unique food and wine. Each had generous servings. You won’t go away hungry even if you have dietary restrictions. (Since I don’t drink wine or beer, I got water, sparkling water or a soda at the places we went. ) Just let Noami know what you can eat.
Noami pointed out interesting sights along the way. The other participants were also a lot of fun. So I highly recommend this tour!

Paola was a great guide. She was very knowledgeable about wine, food and Madrid. The group was very friendly and welcoming. The places we visited were great and Paola recommended a few other places we should visit. I recommend this tour for anyone looking for the easiest way to try multiple locations and get the most out of tapas.

Extraordinary wine, delicious tapas, and terrific guide of the city! I highly recommend this tour. My husband and I were the only ones for this daytime slot and Paula really did a great job showing us the city, giving us the history behind landmarks, and providing suggestions on other things we could do during our visit. Paula was very knowledgeable about the Spanish wines that we had and did a fantastic job ordering tapas that we truly enjoyed (and would not have known to order on our own!) Thank you for an amazing afternoon!

Loved this tour - guide was knowledgeable about Madrid and Spain (having majored in history), and she knew how to lead a group and create a positive atmosphere.
At each stop we had the option between wine, beer, and non-alcoholic drinks.
One note - your enjoyment of this tour will partly depend on the group of people you were with. I feel that I lucked out with a great group that was super fun and friendly.
I enjoyed this tour so much that I ended up doing their Madrid region winery tour as well (which is also excellent).

We were a group of 11 on a stag do, decided to do something different and give this your a go! We were not disappointed! Our guide Marina was friendly, bubbly and very knowledgeable giving us great insight whilst walking the streets of Madrid. We were taken to 4 tapas bars each of which were family run and been around a long time, the oldest bar since 1909! The food and drink were exceptional, pleasantly surprised at how good it was. This tour is highly recommended! 👍🏻

This was such a fun tour. We met five minutes from our house and we chose the afternoon time which was perfect. Carlos was our guide and he was knowledgeable and personable. His English was very easy to understand. He took us to four different stops that were all unique in their own ways. We enjoyed all the wines (and vermut, Sherry and sweet wine, they paired nicely with the delicious food. Our stops were timed nicely.. it felt like we just ‘stopped’ in at the restaurants so we felt like locals. Carlos made sure to address my vegetarian request which isn’t easy in Spain. This is a great tour and we highly recommend it.

The food and wine was fantastic and the commentary provided by Pablo was informative and interesting. The walking was easy and meeting up went exactly as expected. Our group of travellers was very pleasant as well as diverse and the locations we visited were superb. We visited 4 or 5 places over 3 hours and we were full of fantastic eats and delicious drinks. We sampled tapas I never would have tried on my own and the wine was excellent no matter what we had. I only wish I had done this tour at the beginning of my trip to Spain instead of my last night in Madrid.

The time change from the US had us out of sorts and we were late to arrive but the person at the office guided us to the first location where the group had walked and we were greeted with smiles and grace. Marina kept her smile and gracious attitude throughout the tour! We stopped not only at the most authentic and delicious restaurants, but she pointed out several very interesting historical spots along the way. By the end of the tour we felt that we had a good understanding of the culture and food of tapas and had made a few friends as well! Definitely recommend!

Fun and informative tour. Neomi are guide was very knowledgeable and informative. She brought us to fun neighborhood places which really showcased Madrid. She also followed up with email with more tips and information we could use during our stay. We highly recommend this tour!

Sara was a fantastic guide, the places she took us to were fantastic and she was so knowledgeable not only about the food and wine we had but about Madrid in general.

The group of strangers were soon friends, Sara helped us all mingle

The selection of tapas and wine was great and very varied.

Enjoyed one of the places so much we are returning for a 2nd visit

My friends and I went on this Wine and Tapas tour on our last night in Madrid, and we are so glad we did. There was PLENTY of food and wine (we were stuffed and a little tipsy!) and the opportunity to see the city through the eyes of a local is truly priceless. We definitely felt like it was worth the money, if not only to discover some incredible Spanish wines! Rodrigo was a perfect guide. Funny, charming, passionate, and extremely knowledgeable about all that Madrid has to offer. I can not recommend this tour highly enough!

Totally worth every cent. We learned a bit of Madrid history while walking between our stops, had great wine (and beer) and more food than we could eat by the last place. Our guide, Ishmael, was lovely. We met new people and by the end of the night we were like old friends. Perfect thing to do on our last night in Madrid.

This was a fun way to get to know the city and the culture on our first night in Madrid. Carlos made the tour enjoyable, informative and interesting and we got to spend an evening with some lovely people.
This tour is great value and the variety, quality and the quantity of food and wine is excellent. I would really recommend this tour. The tour also accommodated food allergies and food preferences so everyone was happy.

There weren’t many of us on our lunchtime tour, but Carlos certainly made us feel welcome. Interesting tour with some great wine and tapas. We liked one of the venues so much that we went back for lunch the next day!
Wouldn’t hesitate to do it again and quite fancy either the evening or country tour next time.

Tasting wine and tapas in energetic neighborhoods really stood out. While my wife and I were making our fourth trip to Madrid, we had never visited any of the areas we saw on the tour. We have been enriched by the experience.

A really enjoyable evening, an opportunity to chat to other people and drink great tasting wine and tapas. The host was very friendly and gave us an insight into some of the history of Madrid and the places we visited. I would definitely recommend this tour.

Ismael was fantastic - so much local knowledge of Madrid, tapas and wines. We visited some places as tourists would be very hard to find, and the whole experience was very well organised. We were a group of 6 in total, and it was great to share the experience with like-minded individuals. Definitely a highlight of our trip to Madrid, a perfect couples experience.

Our guide, Marina, greeted our group with a smile and the mindset full of historical facts and quickly answered our questions with even more information. She truly is an Ambassador for Spain. The best part of our trip!

Great afternoon with our very enthusiastic and knowledgeable guide Natcho. The tasting venues were well chosen and not the usual tourist traps. The deal was excellent value too, and our group was a very diverse , interesting and fun bunch of people. Would thoroughly recommend this as a good way to get to know the old part of Madrid.

Carlos was a lovely host and made us all feel welcome. He selected four places to visit and each was so different, it made for a really interesting evening. Got to see so much of the city on one night, and even though I was traveling solo I got to have the feeling of being out with my group of friends… which they were, for the night of course! Carlos made sure we were well taken care of including some special diet requests of our group. I am so glad I chose to spend my Saturday on this tour! Especially if, like me, you are traveling solo and want to explore, you should definitely try this.

Absolutely outstanding Tapas and wine! Loved going to generations-old family run businesses. Our guide, Paula, gave us information on the wine terroirs in for the different wines we tasted. We also had the option to try out Vermouth, which I did. It was very good. I'd do this tour again.

We were 7 friends on the tour and it was a great experience. Carlos guided us from place to place and share insights on Madrid as well as the tapas and wine. The group also included other people than our group which further enhanced the tour.

Really fun experience and a great way to learn about Spanish food and culture. We had a group of about a dozen people from all over the world. I was the only American (as always lol) and there was plenty of time to get to know everyone. You're going to be completely filled up but they do provide you with a good amount of various tapas and plenty of wine and vermouth. It's a great way to experience what living in Spain is like as you move from place to place to try different tapas. Our guide was by far one of the best food guides I have ever had. Book the tour, make friends, and have a great time exploring Madrid!

Attended some great local bars and tasted great local dishes. Our guide Carlos did a great job in combining wine with the food and could tell a lot about the wineyards where the wines came from. Excellent value for the money.
Great walk around and learning about wine and tapas. So much more than meets the eye, really enjoyable evening. Anyone looking to understand about this part of Spanish culture, I highly recommend it.
Knowledgeable host called Pablo showed us the sites and sounds of Madrid. We learnt plenty about her history coupled with some fine wines and tapas. Highly recommended and good value for money.

Excellent tour to four unique tapas bars. We sampled a variety of each bars’s specialty. Carlos was knowledgeable about the history of each venue and he gave interesting details about the tapas. Recommended most highly!

Fantastic tour guide Leticia hosted a fun and vibrant evening of tapas, wine and laughter. Great variety of venues and selection of tapas and drinks. Would highly recommend. Group size was perfect (9) and good mix of nationalities.

This was such a fun way to spend the afternoon! Carlos was great introducing us to all the different types of tapas and wines (and there was plenty of both!). It was also nice to meet and talk to the other interesting people on our tour. I would highly recommend this for anyone that enjoys Spanish food and wine.

Thoroughly enjoyed all the places we visited (even went back to a couple of them on other nights as we were so impressed). The wine and food was delicious - surprised myself when I found out some things I'd eaten and liked! Carlos was great - chatty but not over the top and enlightened us with lots of interesting info. A really lovely fun evening.

What a fabulous way to spend an evening! Carlos was a brilliant guide - personable, funny and highly knowledgeable about wine and the regions of Spain. He recommended some delicious wines. I thought I’d be hungry at the end as tapas is traditionally small bites of food - but there was so much to eat I was more than catered for! We had a great group of travellers and the evening was lots of fun. Highly recommend!

Great host ,great food and wine .
The group were great fun . A fantastic evening .the group bonded straight away . This was my first solo trip and I can’t recommend the experience enough

Our guide was amazing. (Apologies I can’t remember the name, Paula maybe??) She was interesting, genuinely friendly and fun to be around. She was knowledgeable about Madrid & it’s history.
We loved the taps bars, we would never have tried them on our own & the food was all so tasty & varied.
We met people from all over the globe, shared stories and had a laugh.
This was a great tour!

Went to places we might not have been able to get into because they’re small and popular. Enjoyed the introduction to tapas we hadn’t tried and new wines. Also offered other beverages for non-wine drinkers. Great fellow tourers from Spain, Germany and Scotland. Happened to be the night that Madrid Real played Liverpool so it seemed like the whole city was out in force. Our last place had a tv so futbol fans to catch the action.

My husband and I did the tapas tour while in Madrid and it was just awesome! Carlos was a fabulous guide; very informative, friendly and attentive. Highly recommend!! Visited 4 bars and had drinks/tapas at each; food and drink absolutely delicious and at each bar the staff were so accommodating and friendly. A “must do” when in Madrid!

We did this our first night in Madrid and had such a good time! Carlos was great, he explained our drink choices and told us about the food we were having at each place. He was very nice and easy to talk to. We loved doing this our first night to kinda get a lay out of the city and find some great places to go. We even went back to one of the places another night we were in town! The wine and food were great everywhere we went!

Nice tour if you’re looking for a quaint local experience. Carlos was super accommodating and fun. Great wine great tapas….

Met great people ended up going off for more wine 🥰

Our tour guide, Noemi, was wonderful and we were lucky to have a fun group. The tapas were amazing and we were happy with every restaurant. You get a full glass of wine/beer at each stop. Noemi also provided a list of additional places to check out. She is very knowledgeable and was able to answer all questions, even behind the scope of the tour. We had a lovely time and would highly recommend as one of the first things to do when you get to Madrid.

Easy to find the tour guide who was very nice. We went to four different tapas restaurants which were all unique. The food was good and everyone was very friendly. All were from the US from different parts so it’s very interesting. Great little tour.

Paula our tour guide was wonderful! Incredibly knowledgeable about the city, food, and specific details about the culture. Most importantly, the food was delicious! Such great tapas from places that are not tourist centric. Had a wonderful time and would certainly do it again.

Interesting and good food and wine. The tour includes visits to 4 tapas restaurants where you try one to 4 different items in each place, plus your choice of wine. The tour guide was a native of Madrid, knowledgeable about wines and friendly. The pace of the Tour is not rushed and very enjoyable. Just a modest amount of walking involved. Would definitely recommend.

Carlos took us on an amazing tour of gourmet Tapas places, some of which were in business for 60 to 100+ years. These were places steeped in tradition and unlikely you would find on your own. Each place was unique and served delicious food. He is very knowledgeable about wine and made excellent recommendations. We met 4 other wonderful couples from Europe and USA and we enjoyed each other’s company with good food and wine. Can’t recommend this tour highly enough.

Tour was very well organized. The chosen bars were very good! And the tapas were some of the best I've in Madrid. The hostess was very friendly and knowledgeable. She was able to tell us a little bit of historical background of the neighborhood where we were. Highly recommended!!

Carlos was funny, kind, and very knowledgeable. We had a blast and the food and wine was all fantastic. My mom had the option for beer bc she doesn’t like wine. We would have never found all those spots or known what to order- highly recommend!

Highly recommend this tour! Our tour guy was very friendly and knowledgeable. Great variety of tapas and wine.

On a different note, we were late to the meeting point and the tour took off. We reach out the number provided and they gave us the location of the first restaurant. Thank you so much!

The group we were with was also great.

My wife and I both agree that this was our favorite of a number of tours we experienced during our trip to Spain. Enrique was a most excellent host and gave us some history of the city and buildings between each tapas bar. The tapas were amazing and the wine was on point. Met some amazing people and will definitely return. Well done Enrique and Gourmet Madrid Tours!

Good food & wine/beer throughout tour - would never have found these bars on our own. We were from the U.K. another group from Southern Ireland plus a family from the U.S.A ….. great combo for the evening.

Rodrigo was the best tour guide EVER! Our group was so fun and Rodrigo made sure our group was having fun and entertained. He also educated us on wines and tapas, and made sure we all had a chance to taste everything. The bars were so cute and welcoming and everything was delicious. Highly recommend the tour to see the nightlife and taste the food, and again Rodrigo was so insightful - best tour guide!

Great tour. Carlos was very knowledgeable and friendly. Took us away from the tourist hotspots for an authentic experience. He did not push for a tip at the end but he really appreciated the tip. It’s very good value for money.
Be sure to go at the beginning of your trip so you know where to avoid for the remainder of your time

Our guide was a poor communicator. Very difficult to hear in a noisy environment. Minimal interaction with the group . She was unprofessional consuming alcohol and the food was actually very ordinary compared to other tours we have taken in Spain.

We not recommend this tour.

Carlos was excellent gave us a brief history of the areas and each establishment. Wine selections were nice and each place was nicer than the one before. Wonderful way to meet others and engage and have a superb time in Madrid. It is a little pricier than other tours but you probably get what you pay for.

This tour was absolutely incredible. Our guide Rodrigo Romojaro was charming, knowledgeable, caring and he made sure everyone was having a good time. We learned a lot about Spanish tapas and wines and also a lot about about the history of Spain and Spanish foods. This was so much more than I expected.
Marilyn

First time doing a tour like this, very enjoyable and well worth the money spent. We were a group of 13, from all walks of life, and by the end of the evening we were like best friends. Carlos was an amazing host. Very personable, and took us to some amazing places.

My taps tour was the night of April 14th. Carlos was our guide. Carlos was passionate about the city, the wine, and the food. He was a great guide and a nice person. The food was great, wine was good too. The places we went were interesting and fun. We had a fun group of people too, which added to the experience. Six of stayed after the tour and had a couple of more drinks together. Carlos did a great job of keeping us moving along from place to place. Just enough time at each restaurant and then on to the next.

Best TA food tour I've ever done! Food and restaurants were terrific, and Carlos was a perfect guide that made us all comfortable. He knew the area so well, and everyone seemed to love him. We stopped at 4 restaurants, all very different. The food and wine were noteworthy at each. Highly recommend. I had consider never booking another food tour after a few bad ones in the states, but this one has redeemed all!

The Gourmet Madrid Wine and Tapas tour was excellent. Our guide Carlos was very knowledgeable, funny, and really made the tour a great time. Each stop included very good tapas and wine, and also gave us an opportunity to meet fellow travelers. Overall, it was a great tour and we’d highly recommend it.

I did this tour with my boyfriend on our second night in Madrid. I would highly recommend! We went to more tapas spots than I anticipated. So much food and wine - definitely a great value! We had fun getting to know others on the tour. The group size was perfect and it felt well-organized.

Were were 4 friends who did the Tapsa & Wine tour in Madrid. We were lucky to have Carlos guiding us in an central Madrid. 4 different types of tapas - from cold Iberian ham to hot prawns in garlic sauce. Every place new fantastic wines or vermut on ice.

Best tour in Madrid - can fully recommend

Absolutely great tour. Superb food and really good fun. My wife really enjoyed the wine. I'm a beer drinker so Carlos our tour guide sorted it for me to drink that at each stop.

Really good fun and I'd highly recommend it.

I have been to Madrid 6 or 7 times and have seen a lot of Madrid with family that live there. I had a day on my own though and was looking for a new experience and I was not disappointed! Met some amazing people (including our guide Noemi) and visited places that I haven't been too before. Madrid has so much to offer and I would highly recommend, whether this is your first or 10th time to Madrid!

Carlos was very informative, energetic and engaged everyone. His tapas venues were all different and fabulous. o waiting in line anywhere and everyone seemed to know him. His choice of wines were also excellent. When we return to Madrid, we intend to hook up with Carlos again. Don't miss this experience.

We booked this tour and couldn’t be happier that we did. We had Marina as our guide and she did an AMAZING job. We met so many people from different countries that were so nice. If in Madrid please book this tour! You won’t regret it. We would do this again when we are back in Madrid! Marina thank you for such an amazing experience.

great fun! walking tour was within 5 minutes of each tavern. there were beer/cocktail options if you didn't want wine. 2 or 3 apps per tavern so plenty of food. great option if you are alone but don't want to eat by yourself! friendly atmosphere. tour guide informative of customs, food, and wine. highly recommend.

We really enjoyed the wine and tapas tour. Carlos was very knowledgeable about the wines of the region and brought us to great local places. It is obvious he truly loves to share his enthusiasm and love for Madrid! This was a top notch experience.

We had a wonderful time with Carlos and he deserved 5 stars as a guide! He was polite, interesting, and highly informative. The only reason we gave the review 4 stars is that while the experience was wonderful, fun, and educational, the food itself was hit or miss. We had delicious garlic shrimp but some of the other tapas left a little more to be desired. Would reccomend going just to drink wine with Carlos however.

Paula put on an excellent tour for us. We experienced 4 lovely tapas restaurants, with a guided walking tour of Madrid. Paula was extremely knowledgeable and provided a really interesting take on Madrid history. Paula's passion for Madrid shined through and really made the tour.

An excellent tour and the highlight of our trip. Would 10/10 recommend. Thanks again, Paula.

Nacho was such an excellent tour guide. He couldn't have packed more information on history, culture and food into the tour. His enthusiasm, friendly manner and knowledge made this a fantastic event that the entire group enjoyed.

Great Experience! We went to 4 places and had several bites and beverages. First place had 3 different dishes to try and 2 glasses of wine. 2nd: also had 3 dishes and a glass of cider and wine. 3rd: was my absolute favorite and it was a shrimp dish. So good. I had wine and my husband had a vermouth drink. And 4th: had 2 dishes and a dessert, with Cava. It was really nice because at each location Ismael would give beverage choices of red wine, white wine, beer, or soda. So it was nice to have options. Also was able to have refills! I would definitely recommend this tour. There was about 13 people on our tour.

This tour gives you an all in one experience with great food, locations, company of small group you meet from all over the world, and learning the history of Spain. Paula was an absolute joy to have as our tour guide. I highly highly recommend this tour!!!

What a fun night! We took this tour our first night in Madrid to get a feel for the area and learn about the local cuisine. Tirna was a vivacious lady and fabulous guide! We stopped at four restaurants along the tour where each offered a choice of wine, beer, cola or water along with several tapas to try. What a great way to learn about the many offered tapas! We had 10 in our tour and it was a lovely mix of couples. There was plenty of food throughout the evening so you won’t need to be finding a dinner spot after. I’d definitely recommend this tour at the beginning of your stay in Madrid!

Really good immersion into Spanish food and wine. Great way to meet with other people travelling. Informative and entertaining guide. Four very different tapas places with their own signature dishes - delicious!
Highly recommend to anyone coming to Madrid for a fun evening out.

The evening was a joy from start to finish. Our guide Carlos was knowledgeable and charming. Food and wine very enjoyable with historical info and fun facts to keep us amused and we all learnt something. Would highly recommend.

Had a fab eve in a small group exploring tapas and wine in a few different venues. Encouraged to try a variety of tapas, meat,veggie, fish and cheese, all washed down with Spanish wines. Our guide explained the history of the places we visited and foods.
Great way to have some fun and meet new people.

Our guide was very enthusiastic and did an excellent job. We learned a lot about Spanish wines and tapas in the beautiful shops and restaurants we went to. We were in a small group, with very nice people and we had a great time.
Nothing to improve.

Manfred was a fabulous guide through Madrid's tapas and wine scene. He is passionate about the food scene and had wonderful recommendations as we tried lots of tapas--many items that we wouldn't have known to try if we were ordering off the menu ourselves. We had a great time with our teenagers and highly recommend this tour!

I am a beginner to wine and Tapas. The guide was very friendly and explained everything with minute details. The history of each wine, the way to drink each wine and the making of each variety was highly informative. Thank you for introducing me to world of wine and tapas

Paula was an excellent guide. Really friendly and knowledgable with great English. Very good at including everyone and encouraging a relaxed and informal atmosphere. We went to traditional tapas bars where we were made very welcome. We tried lots of different delicious tapas with generous servings of excellent local wines. Highly recommend this tour.

The fun host Paola allowed for a welcoming environment and helped with the intermingling with the rest of the tour. It was a fun and pleasant activity for my girlfriend and I. The drinks were great and so was the food. I loved learning as we went. Recommend 10/10 for everyone else.
Paula was a fantastic guide with great insight into the wine and food. Wish we’d done the tour at the beginning vs end of the trip. Lasted closer to 4 hours as our group was having so much fun.

The different cafes, many various tapas and wines were quite good. I was stuffed, with a little wine buzz, when the tour finished with a delicious dessert and sparkling wine. The guide could have spoken more and louder but all in all was delightful.

We really enjoyed our tour. We went to 4 taps bars with our guide Carlos who was very knowledgable and friendly.
The food and wine was very good.
It was also nice to be in a group of people we didn’t know, we met some lovely people from the states and Ireland who were in our group.
We actually went back to one of the places as we really enjoyed the food.
Nice way to start our vacation in Madrid

Exceeded expectations. Guide Paola was fantastic...added great neighborhood and historic background. The 4 stops were hand selected by Paola to highlight family owned and operated businesses, and provide wide variety of tastes. Multiple bites at each stop, all delicious. Red or white wine at each stop. Plenty of opportunity to get to know other tour guests. Great folks with good stories to tell. Highly recommend.

Paula was a phenomenal tour guide. She made the tour engaging and fun! She was incredibly knowledgeable about not only the history of the wine and tapas that we enjoyed, but also the history of Spain and Madrid as well. This was one of the highlights of our trip to Madrid!

We were lucky enough to do this tour yesterday with Carlos as our guide. He was excellent company and very knowledgeable, we thoroughly enjoyed all the places we visited and it was a great way to start our visit to Madrid. Nice to meet the other members of the group of various nationalities. Carlos also gave us some extra recommendations of places to visit whilst in Madrid, he could not have been more helpful, such a nice guy! Book this tour, you will not be disappointed!

This tour exceeded our expectations! The food was exceptional along with the variety of wines we tasted. Each stop was a unique experience. Raul made the trip! His knowledge of wine (he teaches wine classes also) added alot to the experience. I highly recommend this trip as a great introduction to Madrid.

Just came back from an excellent tapas and wine tasting tour in downtown Madrid with Carlos at Gourmet Madrid. Carlos did a great job with making the tour informative and fun. The four places we visited were each unique and the food and drinks were first rate. Very friendly service and great atmosphere as well. Highly recommend the tour and Gourmet Madrid.

This was an entertaining and delicious evening. I highly recommend this tour. Our guide, Carlos, was so personable and informative. We loved spending the evening with a small group who became new friends, and walking together to each new place. We enjoyed the many different and delicious tapas dishes. I had my first experience drinking delicious straight vermouth which is done in Madrid, but new to me! Plus we drank lots of good wine and learned a lot about Spanish customs and foods and wines. Worth every penny!
A great way to have easy access to many great tapas with great wine. We never would have found so many neat places and experiences in 2-3 hours on our own. Tour guide was great and knowledgeable!

Our Neomi was a thorough guide. She took us to restaurants that locals go to so it was a nice way to discover places we might not have on our own. The food was fantastic and the restaurants were prepared for us despite a busy Saturday afternoon. We loved our group and had great conversations. Highly recommend

Our tour guide, Marina, was a fantastic. Her knowledge of Madrid, food and wine was articulated fluently. She was a pleasure to have conversations with outside of food too. Thank you for the memorable experience and making us feel comfortable.

Carlos was a fantastic and very knowledgeable guide. He put us at ease from the start of the tour and was helpful in his suggestions for future places to see and eat in Madrid. I visited Madrid solo but the tour made me feel like I was right at home!
I was not able to find the place, try to call host in the number provided in the voucher and was not able to contact him... so I end up missing it ...

I want to start this by saying I have done a few tours like this in Europe, including on another occassion in Madrid so I have comparison points.

I have no comprehension how this tour scores so highly on Tripadvisor. The only positive I have to say is that there was some nice people on the tour to chat to (whose opinions varied from mildly disaapoined to visibly agrieved).

The tour goes to "local places" - the only people in the restaurants / cafes were OTHER TOURISTS.

The wine? Got little more of a description than red or white and pointing on a map to where it came from. The tour guide got annoyed when I asked a few questions at the first location - I didn't ask anymore.

The food? Varied from mediocre to poor / indedible. Everyone on the group arrived hungry - at least 3 of us, all women, went for more food (and decent wine) afterwards as we were not full. The food was of such poor quality, that the bread was what was devoured. This was a group of 10 people of all ages, from accross the world - we can't all have been "picky".

The tour guide? Apart from doing a basic introduction to the history of the place we were about to visit, asking if we wanted red or white (I kid you not), and hurrying us out of one place to the next, interacted with us very minimally. Although, I didn't mind the hurrying on as I couldn't wait for the tour to end.

There was a lot of food left behind (as it simply was not nice) and wine left in glasses (as we were hurried along so much and sometimes just was not nice).

Please do not this Madrid Wine and Tapas tour - you will neither learn anything nor enjoy yourself.

We took the afternoon tour a few days ago and cannot recommend it enough. Our group was made up of 3 couples and our guide Carlos. We went to four different restaurants, tasted many, many delicious tapas dishes, along with some really wonderful wine. Carlos did the ordering at each establishment, choosing the dishes each restaurant was known for and making sure we had a great variety of meat, fish, vegetables, cheese, etc. But this tour is much more than a gastro experience. Through Carlos we learned so much about Spanish history, customs, geography, etiquette and much more! Thank you so much Carlos for giving us such a memorable afternoon!

I am a solo traveler who enjoys exploring new locations at the beat of my drum. However, on every trip I squeeze in a few local guided tours so that I can enjoy the company of diverse individuals, with unique stories, passing through the same location. I am happy to report that my guided tapas and wine tour is probably one of my all-time top 3 favorites. My tour guide Paula was very polite and welcoming, and the group members were educated and had great personalities. I did not eat before the tour, and by the end, I was beyond full and tipsy! I was introduced to some fantastic, tasty wines and I live in California where our local wine selection is excellent. If you are a solo traveler and are looking for a great time out do this tour. You will not regret it!

A group of us did this tour on our first night to acclimate ourselves with the city and it was the best decision we made!
Carlos was SO nice, funny and informative during the tour-- we went to 4 places and they gave us more than enough food.
Afterwards, Carlos gave us suggestions where to grab a drink for those of us who wanted to go out after the tour
I definitely recommend this tour if visiting Madrid for a weekend like we did!

This was really disappointing. The photos of the food are very misleading suggesting an array of quality tapas when only the very last place was of good quality. The first place we were taken to was very ordinary with cheap wine. I dont think this tour is good value for money considering how inexpensive tapas and wine are in Madrid.

I am new to food tasting tours...this is only my second one..and I loved the experience. I was by myself with a Danish couple and two friends from Boston. Our host, Carlos was awesome. He was very engaged throughout the tour, shared his experiences, listened to us.. he was great !! I liked the fact that they accept solo travelers.. many don't. We visited four great tapas places. Spent about 20-30 min in each (I think). The food was great. The garlic shrimp, and the fried bacon, was great. The wine selection was awesome. I learned a lot from the experience, the conversations with the group was nice. Altogether it was a great evening. If you haven't ever done a food tour, this is great one to start with .. and you will remember the experience. Thank you for experience guys !!
Rodrigo was awesome!!! 5 stars! We learned so much about the wines and the tapas! Ask for Rodrigo if possible :)

My husband booked this tapas & wine evening tour for our daughter & especially to celebrate our granddaughter’s college graduation. So we, the party of four, along with 4 other participants (2 from Phoenix, Arizona & 2 from Pittsburg to DC, all from the USA) led by a seasoned, funny & friendly tour guide, Rodrigo Romojaro who attended to every person’s needs, ventured on 12/27/19 evening for what turned out to be an unforgettable evening of fun, laughters, friendship bonding, wine tasting & toasting, serious eating, various never-tried before tasty tapas & delicious wines. Visited 4 cozy restaurant/bar hopping from one to the other within a few hrs period..the group was extremely close knit even though we just met that evening..was such a coincident that two were from Phoenix, Arizona where our daughter & granddaughter were from. We enjoyed these few hrs like they were our last event for the vacation trip, exchanged contact info and other pleasantries before we call it the night..most enjoyable tour booked by my husband. Kudos to the tour guide who I think deserves accolades and if his boss is reading this, deserves a raise & more tour sessions assigned..he is that great!

Worth noting the 4 bars/restaurants & my likes:
1. Casa Gonzalez - Jamon Iberico
2. El Lacon - Callos (tripe) & Cazon (fried baby shark cubes)
3. Taberna Fontan - Berenjena Con Miel (fried eggplants with honey glazed) Note: my favorite dish..so much so that I returned to this restaurant two nights later for the same melts-in-your-mouth dish!
4. Casa Del Abuelo - Gambas al Ajillo (garlic shrimp in sizzling olive oil)

No pictures because everyone were too busy drinking, eating, chit-chatting & bonding! It was magical for this Christmas/New Year, 2019! 🥳😊

let a great guide take the strain of working out which tapas places to go , had super evening different places tapas and drinks with a bunch of interesting other travellers- what's not to like? The evening flowed well after a few busy bars we had great food in a quieter sit down restaurant - perfect

Unfortunately I think our tour guide was a little tuckered out. A couple of the restaurants were not exactly pleased to see the group, perhaps they were tired as well. It was a wonderful way to meet other people who were traveling and enjoying Madrid.

I have been on food and wine tours in many parts of the world and have found them very educational. The Madrid Tapas and Wine Tasting Tour is in my opinion just a very expensive night out with strangers. The educational component is minimal and goes out the window after the first restaurant.There were too many people in the group for it to have been educational (we were over 14 in our group). After a drink or two most participants were in a party mood and it was too noisy to hear the tour leader Carlos. There was no advice on how to chose a tapas bar or how to order.
We visited 2 restaurants 2 bars and tasted a variety of dishes. There wasn’t enough food ordered to be full at the end of the tour; probably because the tour had more than 12 participants.
At each restaurant you had to chose either beer, red or white wine or Cava; there was no tasting of various types of wine. At one restaurant we tasted cider; that was the only occasion we were given a sample versus a full glass.
I was very disappointed as the tour was an expensive waste of time.
Rodrigo our guide was fabulous! We felt as is we were enjoying an afternoon with friends! His selections of tapas and locations were wonderful! One of my favorite adventures in Madrid!

What a great way to get a taste of the city. Rodrigo was a blast. He was very knowledgeable, entertaining, thoughtful and accommodating. He followed up immediately with the places we visited and the foods we tasted as well as the wines we sampled. If you don’t have a lot of time in this city, this is a great way to get a taste of the town!

This tour was very enjoyable and as advertised, there was plenty to eat and drink. Our tour included stops at four different bars with as much as we wanted to drink (choices were usually red or white wine or beer) and several different kinds of tapas at each place. We were on an evening tour (7:30 PM) and we didn't wrap up until almost 11! Our guide was a little difficult to understand at times (either due to volume or accent) but he was enthusiastic and informative. He gave us a tour around the areas we visited but what I really appreciated were his recommendations of places to eat or shop that were not on the tour (we had dinner the following night in one of the restaurants he recommended.) My one disappointment was that although I had communicated with Gourmet Madrid to alert them that my boyfriend was gluten intolerant, the guide had not been made aware (fortunately my boyfriend had brought his own GF bread and crackers.)

But overall, a fun, worthwhile tour!

Book this tour immediately if you want an authentic and flavorful taste of Madrid.  Our tour guide, Carlos, went out of his way to create a fun, educational and wine-infused experience that left our group gastronomically satisfied.  Each of the 4 restaurants were not only unique in their tapas offerings, but also in their architecture and history. If you have a choice in tour guides, ask for Carlos...he will not disappoint!

Our guide, Carlos, was wonderful. We had a wide variety of tapas and visited a good sampling of places. We had a diverse group which made the experience even better, getting to know our fellow travelers. Food was plentiful. Carlos did a great job giving us the background of the wines we were drinking as well of the dishes and places we were visiting. Would definitely recommend!

While in Madrid we attended an excellent Tapas tour conducted by Paula Gil-Casares.
Paula was very informative, friendly and approachable. She took us to 4 different hand selected Tapas Restaurants. The menu items selected for us I would have never selected on my own but all were VERY good. Paula also introduced us to some excellent Spanish wines.

We did this tour on our first day in Madrid so we would know some good places to eat and would also get a little tour of the close by area. Paula gave us many interesting facts about the area and knew the family owned restaurants & their histories as well. I would highly recommend this tour.

The tapas tour in the letters district with Paula was a highlight of our time in Madrid. We appreciated that she pointed out the culturally relevant locations in this older area of Madrid while showing us the places that locals frequent and that most tourists would simply pass by.

Mario was a lot of fun. We met at Plaza Santa Ana and went to our first place.

Here we discussed with type of wines we like and how they categorize them in Spain. We had a Jamón and cheese platter, cheese and jelly on bread, and a meat with honey on bread. I had a glass of white wine. It’s a real pour. You can also get beer.

2nd stop we started going with reds. We are introduced to the tapas that come WITH an alcohol drink. We got all 4 choices. Tripe with chick peas, lentils, asparagus, potatoes with Jamón, and dogfish.

3rd stop is for the seafood lovers! Garlic shrimp and fresh bread. We also got tomatoes. We made cute little sandwiches with it all.

4th stop most wanted beer, but I stuck with red wine. We had Spanish omelet, pork belly, and I believe 2 other tapas.

One of our favorite tours we did while in Madrid. We booked it for the night we arrived, and it was an excellent way to experience some of the finest tapas and wines offered in Madrid. Our guide, Nacho, was fantastic and had selected the perfect places to sample the different specialties. Our group was such a fun mix of people, and made the tour even more enjoyable. Highly recommend!

Carlos was our guide on this tour and he was fantastic! We went to four different places and the choices Carlos made for the tapas was well worth it! He explained each of the regions the wines came from and I was never disappointed with any of the wines or vermouth that I chose. The group had a mixture of couples and solo travelers, and it was like dining with friends. Would definitely recommend this tour to anyone!
We loved our tour with Raul. He was incredibly knowledgeable about the food, wine and the city. Can't recommend this tour highly enough!

Such a great experience, it really gives you the feel for the culture in Madrid! I highly recommend doing this for a fun night, you get to meet new people, taste tapas foods and try new wines such a great time❤️

This is the best food & wine tour I've ever been on and Rodrigo is absolutely the best tour guide I've ever had! He is funny, personable and knowledgeable. We had a blast and and enjoyed so much food & drink, as well as history and culture lessons. Would absolutely recommend!

Great tour, very good value considering the amount of food and wine. Our guide, Paula, was great: knowledgeable, attentive, and funny. I lived in Madrid years ago and wanted my wife to experience a paseo. We were not disappointed. Great start to get oriented to this wonderful city.

It's not wine tasting, but rather a glass of wine at each stop, you choose red or white. It was nice, the tapas were good, however, the bars were so busy, our group was not able to be together, we had to spred out which also made it difficult to share the tapas. I would not recommend doing this on a Saturday night. The tour guide was great. Overall, had a great time.

Rodrigo was fabulous! He was delightful and so knowledgeable about Madrid and its culinary delights! We visited four tapas bars to enjoy a variety of tapas and wines. It was lovely to visit with people from all over the world. The food was amazing.. company was fun... and everyone was stuffed at the end. The only recommendation we had was to make sure to visit bars with room for all to sit. I know it’s hard because the bars are so small. Highly recommend Rodrigo and his tour...he made it a blast!

Guide Carlos led us to four local spots that we might have missed entirely on our own, where we sampled some typical tapas dishes and an assortment of Spanish wines. We even revisited one of the restaurants later in our trip, and it was just as delicious.

This was great fun! We joined a group of enthusiastic new friends and all joined in the experience with gusto. Carlos knows his way around and led our merry band to some of the best taste treats in the area. He was especially kind and accommodating to us, which we appreciated, and his knowledge made the evening especially enjoyable. Plus we couldn't have joined a better group. Everyone was curious, open-minded and very interesting to get to know. We would have liked to have had more time in Madrid with the same fun group!

This was such a great time with a wonderful guide—Manfred—and a bunch of fun and interesting and chill tourists who wanted to experience awesome food in an awesome city. We did this on our first full day in Spain and it oriented us to the tapas culture and food we could expect over the next two weeks. Manfred was super smart, interesting and fun and made the whole experience so enjoyable!

Great experience - excellent food, wine, stories and can thoroughly recommend. Rodrigo expertly guided as around the old town to four different restaurant/bars an even through a rain downpour! Such a vibrant and fun city centre.

We visited four restaurants and got to try an assortment of tapas dishes. Each of the restaurants we visited were different. The wines were very good, you had a choice of the type of wine you wanted. Our guide was extremely friendly and knowledgeable. Be sure to go hungry.

It was a pleasure night. The group was nice and the guide “ Rodrigo” made everything work well.
It was a good choice of a night out for a person alone.

It was a great tour. A little history...a little wine paring... and a lot of good food. It was great meeting new people and sharing the adventure.
We visited four tapas bars. A little over 3 hours. Everything covered by the fee. Plenty to drink and eat.

This is a great tour! Loved meeting people from different places. The food was good and the wine was great. They were able to meet my gluten free options on most items! Highly recommend! Great way to see the city and experience the food and culture!

We were so glad to book this on our first night in Madrid! The tour guide was great and the best thing was the small group so we were able to get to know other people and make new friends. The bar selection was awesome as well! Awesome time...you should do this!!

This tapas tour was much more than expected. You get to go to four different tapas bars throughout the city Madrid. You meet in a central location, and walk as a group to all the restaurants, so you get to see some of the city along the way.

Our tour guide, Raul, was wonderful. He was easy to understand and was super knowledgeable about the history of the city and the food. He was super personable and made the tour a lot of fun.

Let's talk about the most important thing, the food! It was delicious, and I think there is something for everyone to enjoy. We had one person allergic to seafood, and one was a vegetarian, and they still enjoyed themselves. Also, every stop you get to try the local wine or drink recommenced which is really cool. I probably would have never tried a lot of the food and drinks i had, if it wasn't for this tour. Our favorite stop was the shrimp restaurant, and we even wound up going back the following day because it was that good!

The group size of the tour makes it very personal. I think we had about 12 people total. This allowed us to get to know the people we were with and enjoy the whole experience together. We even wound up meeting up after the tour and going out that night together.

9/10 would recommend. Only one point was deducted because the last stop the food was cold, but other than that, it was amazing!

This is a great tour. We were a group of three friends who joined this group. We had such a laugh, met some great people, ate delicious food and of course drank lovely wine. Our guide was a gentleman - super friendly and informative about the area. This tour was the highlight of our trip.
Garlic shrimp was amazing! Host was also great highlighting the regions the wine was from, taking us to places I would not have found myself and picking great tapas. Thanks!

This tour was excellent. This was our first time to Madrid and we spent our first day wandering all the tourist areas around our hotel. The second night we did the tour. We visited 4 bars, all old and all known for a special taps. The food was amazing and plentiful. We all left satisfied but not uncomfortable. The tour gave us a nice history of the establishments we visited and the area we walked through. The small group character of the tour also allowed us to get to know each of our fellow travelers. We had a nice mix of countries represented and totally enjoyed the tour and our group. We highly recommend this tour during your stay and doing it at the beginning as we went back to some of the places the next evening.

Fantastic night with a great guide. Food was amazing at restaurants we probably would have never found. Enrique our guide was great and gave us loads of information about the food, wine and local area. Would definitely recommend this tour.

The best part of our Madrid stay was this wonderful tapas & wine tour. Raul, our tour guide was kind & generous. He helped facilitate a fun time among 12 strangers from around the world. By the time we had stopped at the 4th Tapas bar, we all were good friends laughing together. Could not have been better. Oh...and the food & wine was delicious too.
I highly recommend this tour as it is so worth it. I got to try a variety of tapas that I would never have ordered on my own if I didn't know about it. The wine was amazing too. A must-do in Madrid!

We had a pleasant evening and the guide was a nice guy, but at €150 for two, I really feel it was overpriced. The tapas was largely mediocre in my opinion, except for the freshly prepared shrimps in garlic which were delicious. I much preferred the evening meal we had in the 5* hotel, Barcelo Torre de Madrid's restaurant 'Somos.' It cost just over half the price of this tapas tour, including with a dessert each and a bottle of wine! I really don't understand all of the 5* reviews here - perhaps they didn't pay full price.
Loved visiting our guide’s favourite tapas bars. Had some outstanding food and met some lovely people. Highly recommend.
Excellent introduction to tapas and regional food and wines. Carlos was a great guide and I would not hesitate recommending this tour.

If you want to experience local bars/ restaurants that tourists typically will not find on their own, then this is the tour for you. As our guide said - the dirtier the floor, the better the place, which is definitely not a concept most of us are familiar with. Really good local Spanish food coupled with great choices in wines makes this a great way to spend a few hours in Madrid, at the end of which you'll definitely leave feeling full.
Very enjoyable,guide Carlos was excellent,knew his wines and tapas.his knowledge and history of the area was very I formative. Would recommend this tour. Pity about the weather🙈

Highly recommend this tour for off-the-beaten path, “non-touristy” food and wine. We had 12 people total plus our guide so big enough group to have fun but small enough to have individual conversations. The bars/restaurants were unique and very tasty! You would definitely need to be a local to know their location and their known specialties. Come hungry and thirsty because food was too good to pass up (even if you were completely full) and drinks were flowing!

Based on the good reviews we reserved the tour for a (rainy...) evening in April. Upon arrival at a central square in Madrid the participants were split in two groups and we joined a group of 6 other people, all from the USA (we live in Germany). Our guide Carlos took us to four different tapas restaurants, all a few hundred meters apart. During our walk he told a little bit about the history of Madrid and the buildings we passed. We were really lucky that our fellow-participants were interactive and communicative, so the atmosphere was excellent. Food was good and the restaurants we visited were sometimes unusual and very traditional. That is the good thing of this tour, you visit places you would probably skip being a tourist and unknown to the city. Our criticism goes out to the price (you can have a really exclusive meal for € 75 pp in Madrid), to the label of "wine tasting" (there is no real tasting, the bottles aren't even placed on the table), and the guide, who could have spent more time with his guests in the restaurants. But it remains a good start of a visit to Madrid.

Carlos was our guide and he was great from the beginning to the end. We had a great group of American couples/people and one from the UK.

Carlos got us all to say where we were from, introduced the tour and the plan and took us onto the first of four places.

We tried wine in each of the four places, and also 1-2 different dishes along the way. There was plenty of food.

Carlos had the answers to all of our questions, and explained the food in detail. He also explained it's origin, pointing to a map of where it was from.

If you're visiting Madrid then I would wholeheartedly recommend this tour. I believe it is priced well, you're getting 4 drinks + around 8 different tapas style dishes.

We had such a great tour with Paula, our guide. She was funny and knowledgeable our the food and wine of Madrid and the places she brought us to were excellent! Our group got along great. It really was one of the best things we did in Madrid.

Tour was great - Paula combined great food places with a lot of background to Madrid and some important places. Also she was really entertaining, it was just a great time. Highly recommend to do this tour, all place were amazing. Thanks again for this super time :)

Jim was our guide for the evening. We visited shops we would never have found by ourselves. But Jim being our guide was very knowledgeable about in and out of dining in Madrid as well as the history of the city. It was a very entertaining evening. I would recommend this outing if you're visiting Madrid for the first time.

Enrique was a wonderful guide. My wife and I did a similar tour in Venice a couple years ago and this one was just as good. Wonderful food and great wine. We left feeling more confident about ordering local food in Madrid.

Great way to begin your trip in Madrid. We got the walking tour to understand where we were. The restaurants and wine selections were terrific. Our guide was great! No need to eat dinner as the tapas are filling and generous. Great tour!

Like a few others have noted in the reviews this is a fantastic tour of some local eateries to do upon arriving to Madrid. After a long journey and while getting acclimated to our new surroundings we were carefree knowing that our evening was all planned out. Carlos, our guide, did a marvelous job showing us around; explaining each dish and the histories of all the establishments. For me the highlight was El Lacón where we got to try Cazón en adobo — a marinated fish so delicious that my wife and I returned another evening for it. And she doesn’t usually enjoy seafood so that says something! It was a pleasure meeting the other 3 members of our small group, and I expect they enjoyed the tour equally.

Carlos was an excellent guide. I was solo only 1st trip to Madrid. I found this tour via TripAdvisor and cannot recommend it highly enough. Learned a lot and met some great people, and saw so much that I never could have on my own. Mix of solos and couples. Carlos accommodated everyone’s food preferences and so much fun!

This was an excellent tour led by Mr Nacho. He provided great history and the bars, wine, and tapas were fantastic. Definitely worth the money and a great way to get acquainted with the city on day 1 or 2. A little bias but we had a nice mix of people in the group - couples, family, and singles. Can’t say enough good things.....

I had an incredible time during the tapas and wine tour in Madrid. I was traveling solo and it was a great way to explore the city with a great group of travelers from around the world. Paula was an awesome guide!! Being born in Madrid, she was very passionate about her city and culture, and she spent a lot of time explaining the city history, food and wine. Paula also took the time to take photos of the group and email them to us. The food was great and the wine delicious! Highly recommend!

If your time in Madrid is short this tour is a great way to get a flavour of the amazing food and wine to be had in the city. Our guide was Carlos and he took the group, 2 grits, 1 from Hong Kong and a wide selection of Canadians and Americans, to 4 amazing and varied restaurants. We samples wines from all over Spain and a selection of really tasty tapas dishes. The architecture and decor of the places we visited were just as much of the fun as the food itself. Sharing these experience of and simply chatting to others in the group makes the tour a really social and fun experience. Just over 3 hours very well spent.

Paula, our tour guide made our tour so much fun. She took us to 4 different tapa bars, giving us information all along the way. As we tasted each wine and tapa, she explained about the importance of the regions where the wines came from and about the tapas we tasted. Each place was different which gave a great perspective of what to expect in her fabulous city.

This walking tour was a great experience mostly due to our bubbly and very informative guide, Paula! We visited 4 bars tried lots of different tapas and 4 different wines. There was plenty to eat and drink. It was also an opportunity to meet some other very lovely fellow travellers. Overall a great evening, which Paula has now followed up by emailing each of us detailed notes on the food and wine we tried on the night. Highly recommended as a fun night out!!

We don’t speak Spanish so going to tapas bars and trying to figure out what to order can be challenging. This made it so easy for us. Our guide, Carlos, took care of everything. He gives you a dose of local history, culture and some Spanish phrases to learn/avoid. He ordered all the food and wine and paid the tabs at every place. We just showed up, met some great fellow guests and enjoyed the wine and tapas. By the end of the night we were stuffed and had a blast. We highly recommend this tour!!

We took the lunch tour late June. We were supposed to be four people but two didn't make it so we had a private tour for two.
Our guide took us to 4 places which I would call hidden gems - places I probably wouldn't stop at by myself, but were incredibly nice.
We had a great guide, great food, great wine and other treats.
All in all - this tour is highly and warmly recommended by me (-:

The tour was lovely. A great way to learn about the food and wine and also a bit of Spanish culture. We met really lovely people too and that made the evening really special. Paula, the guide was really nice and well informed. The places we visited were lovely. I'll do it again next time in Madrid 👌
Did this tour on our first night in Madrid - we would have never tried or even been able to find the great restaurants that Carlos led us to. Fun night despite the pouring rain!

First, Enrique did a fantastic job on this wine and tapas tour. He was knowledgeable, personable, answered all questions, made sure everyone in the group was taken care of during the tour. He shared a tremendous amount of local information about Madrid and is an accomplished wine maker and musician! Could not have asked for a better tour guide! The group we were with was really fun and from different backgrounds. Getting to know the group was very interesting and we had lots to talk about and laughed often. After the tour, our group decided to stay together at the last restaurant and enjoy another bottle of wine.

Had a very nice time with our wine/tapas guide through Madrid. We went to some spots that definitely weren't on our list of places to eat or drink at but they were all top notch!!

The food and wine had at all 4 places was very good. The last stop was a little letdown with me and a guy next to me getting the last pours of the red wine and ended up with a LOT of sediment in our glasses. Didn't really hurt anything but nobody likes getting a mouth full of sediment on the last drink! We also weren't allowed to buy additional wine at the last place even though everyone drank their glass before all of the tapas were out so went to water.

My fiance and I only had a couple nights in Madrid and wanted to find a way to explore a bit of the nightlife of Madrid thru its' tapas and wine. We came across this tour and decided to give it a try because it had great reviews and was also a smaller, more intimate group. We couldn't have been happier with our choice. Enrique, our tour guide, was professional, knowledgeable and really helped us understand the nuances of the Spanish tapas and wine world. We walked to four very different locations around Madrid (short walks) and each venue had some sort of specialty that we were able to focus on.

The wine was great, the conversations were nice and of course the tapas were fantastic. Enrique even got my fiance to try new things and she was so happy she did!

Not being night owls and people who eat very light dinners, we decided on the afternoon tour. From beginning to end, Paula was informative, friendly, interesting and we could tell was passionate about history and the arts, especially of Madrid. We were also quite lucky as we were only a group of 4 which gave us plenty of time to ask questions. We went to 4 family-owned bars that have been in existence for generations - 3 in the Letras or Arts neighborhood and the last in Plaza Mayor. At each bar, we tasted a different white or red wine (and vermouth) from different regions of Spain, and Paula explained the differences of each region. The tapas she picked for us to taste ranged from the typical Iberian ham and cheese to shrimp in garlic (gambas al ajillo) to cazon (shark) in cumin - all so delicious and filling. A wonderful, fun, and great learning experience! Muchas gracias, Paula. We absolutely recommend this tour and Paula as guide.

The Tapas Tour is most certainly the best way to start your journey in Madrid.
The tour takes you near Plaza Mayor, through places known as “bodegas” and “tabernas” with each their own exquisite specialty tapas. Most establishment are crowned with the coveted Tapas plaque sealed in front of their doorstep, some visited by Ernest Hemingway during his residency here in the early 1900’s.
It is a tour that provides friendship and conviviality (the wine help).
Among the many, stood the fried calamari with squid ink sauce, Manchego cheese, fresh spinach frittata, purple potatoes, fluffy ham croquette, baked garbanzo bean and of course plenty of world-famous Serrano Ham.
My favorite was “Casa del Abuelo” for their very famous garlic shrimp also complimented by an excellent Spanish house wine.
Our guide, Manfred, spoke very good English and was very knowledgeable about the history behind the tour, the food and even the wines we tried.

Booked this for my husband and I- was questioning a bit whether we should have booked; I am quite a picky eater, and while I can generally find something on just about any menu that I’ll enjoy, I was nervous about depending on choices for a group... this tour absolutely did not disappoint. Our guide had me eating things I would never have chosen or thought I’d enjoy, and completely loving them. Had the opportunity to go to several places we’d never have found on our own. Also ended up being a great value for the money- on top of having a guide for the evening, we were stuffed with more than enough food and four full glasses of wine. Would 100% recommend!!

What a great night we all had together. Strangers, enjoying Tapas and Wine and learning a bit of history along the way. I always try and take food tours when visiting a new city, as it is a great way to learn about the local culture. We tried so many different food items, that I would not have known to try if it were not for this tour. The wine was delicious, as was the food. Carlos did a great job as our guide! I highly recommend this tour!

It was a very interesting and useful tour. We found very nice and cozy locations and stories about Madrid. Carlos was very talented in getting us into the Madrid's gourmet specialties.

thank you Carlos !!!

We had a great time on the Tapas tour in Madrid. Paula, our local tour guide, was exceptional.
