She was friendly and knowledgeable about the places we visited, as well as the city and country as a whole. She provided us with background information about each of the restaurants, as well as where each of the wines we tried came from. We enjoyed meeting other people from around the world and hearing their stories. The food, wine, and company was phenomenal, what more could you ask for?

We had a wonderful afternoon on the tour with Carlos. He was very knowledgeable about the city, the food, and the wine. As well as being entertaining and a great conversationalist. At each stop the food and wine served were delicious and the information educational. As promised, we later received an email with the details of every restaurant, the food, and the wine. We couldn't have asked for any better of an experience.
We really enjoyed our tapas and wine tour and highly recommend doing this. Our guide was really friendly, funny and a joy to spend the three hours with.

My fiancé and I booked this tour to get a snapshot of some food and drinks in Madrid. The food was delicious, and I was really happy with the variety of tapas. Our tour guide, Noemí, was really kind and knowledgable. The vendors she took us to felt intentionally curated and authentic. She did a great job of sharing some history of the streets we walked, and helped cultivate a chill vibe. We all ended up making friends with the other people in the tour. She also gave thoughtful recommendations for other things to do in Madrid. This was a fantastic way to soak up a lot of Madrid in a short time. Highly recommended.
Our guide Marina was amazing! She was friendly, knowledgeable, and it was the highlight of our vacation so far. It was an unforgettable experience! Highly recommend for anyone visiting!

Absolutely amazing, no complaints ! Marina did an absolutely fantastic job! The food was fantasic good history talks, just an overall great time! Only suggestion is to have a sign people can see when meeting, that says maybe "Tapas Tour" just on a piece of paper that you can throw away when everyone has gathered. I thought I was going to miss it because I wasn't sure what group was mine, but luckily Marina was super attentive and caught me looking around, so it worked out!
Excellent tour great food and drink hosts were very friendly. Group was the right size too. Nice pace during the night.

My wife and I took the Ruta De Vinos Y Tapas tour with Carlos as our tour guide. I can’t give enough praise to Carlos. He is a fabulous guide providing an entertaining evening filled with local Madrid history peppered with some general information about Spain. Whether we were walking between or at the four locales Carlos provided a continual stream of information, witticisms and commentary that rounded out a pleasurable experience.

The four establishments we went to are listed below along with the wine and tapas selections. As my wife and I prefer red wines we stayed within our comfort zone and enjoyed the reds except for the third stop, where we experienced a very fine vermouth, Lacuesta. I would rate it as a top 10. Each of the reds was exceptional. Others on the tour who drank the white wines expressed the same feeling.

CASA GONZÁLEZ
Wines: Red: +7. D.O. Priorat. Red Garnacha, Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon
White: Jaspi Blanc. D.O. Terra Alta. White Garnacha (70%) Macabeo (30%).
Foods: Tosta de Jamón ibérico (Iberian ham on toast)
Tosta de Arzúa con membrillo (Arzúa cheese and quince on toast)
Tosta de morteruelo (Morteruelo on toast)

EL LACÓN

Wines: Red: Juan Gil. D.O. Jumilla. Monastrell.
White: Juan Gil. D.O. Jumilla. Moscatel.

Foods: Croquetas caseras de jamón (Homemade ham croquettes)
Cazón en adobo (Marinated dog fish)
Lacón a la gallega (Pork shoulder Galician style)
Berenjenas con miel (Eggplant with honey)

CASA DEL ABUELO

Wines: Red: La viña del abuelo. D.O. Toro. Tinta de toro.
White: La viña del abuelo. D.O. Rueda. Verdejo.
Sweet red: Vino tinto dulce El Abuelo. D.O. Toro.
Vermouth: Lacuesta.

Foods: Gambas al ajillo (Garlic shrimps)

LOS GALAYOS

Wines: Red: Generación del 27. D.O. Vinos de Madrid. Tempranillo.
White: Puerta del Sol. D.O. Vinos de Madrid. Malvar.
Cava: Agustí Torrelló Mata. D.O. Cava. Macabeo, Parellada, Xarel-lo.

Foods: Tortilla española (Spanish omelette)
Puntillitas con huevo y pimientos (Baby Squid with fried egg and grilled
peppers)
Croquetas de queso (Cheese croquettes)
Torrija con helado de turrón (French toast with nougat ice cream)

I would recommend this tour to everyone. A fantastic evening with a fantastic guide.
Great time with Carlos and the crew. Vey nice food, wine, historical explanations. Would definitely recommend this to friends and family.

Carlos was a great guide. It was the perfect first night in Madrid experience, especially meeting the others in the group. The Tapas and wine selections were fabulous. If i was to choose, what was the best it would be the first taste of membrillo and cheese and the best garlic prawns ever. So good. Carlos listened to what people wanted and managed to accomodate that. I sign of a great host and that is what he was

We had a wonderful evening exploring Madrid! There were four of us on the tour and we met your guide exactly at the time planned. We walked around different areas of the city exploring the food. The neighborhoods were bustling and in addition to learning about the food we also learned about the culture and history of the city. Carlos was a great guide for the night, he answered all the questions we had. The food was all delicious, our favorite spot was the shrimp, but everything we tasted was delicious, and we left stuffed. I would book this tour over and over when I come to Madrid!
Amazing!!! Rodrigo is an incredible guide and made the experience very fun. The food and the places were amazing and the people were so friendly!
Our guide Enrique was knowledgeable and insightful. Took us into hidden gems within the city. Would recommend the tour to anyone who loves wine and is not a vegetarian.

The tour covers for tapas bars and includes food and wine at each location. Carlos, the guide made it an interesting and fun tour. My friend is a vegetarian and he made sure there was plenty of food for her at each stop.

The bars we went to were filled with locals and definitely weren’t tourist traps like many.

I’d go back to any of them on my own if I was back in Madrid.

I booked this tour for my first time visiting Madrid. My friend and I were excited to try the local cuisine and wine. We had such a wonderful experience with Paula! She was extremely knowledgeable about the city's history, culture, various neighborhoods, and took us to some really great local places. The food and wine at each restaurant were amazing. I highly recommend taking this tour while in Madrid!

Our guide Rodrigo was awesome and even better were the places he took us to drink and eat. It was a great atmosphere, people from Singapore, Wyoming, Alabama and California were in this trip and they were all great. Overall great experience
The tour was mostly a food and wine tour, the tapas places was within few minutes walking distance. Very good experience of the local food and wine, I tasted many new food favorites.

Mario was engaging and knowledgeable about his wine. He went into depth about the wines we sampled and was able to answer all questions and then some. We ended up with 5 couples and a single person. What added to this experience was that each couple was from a different country. We had Germany,2 from Australia, Canada, and us from the USA. We all enjoyed the food and wine. Each restaurant he took us to served us 3-4 dishes and The tapas was delicious! This was truly an experience we will remember.

Fabulous tour! We only had a one night stop over in Madrid, & lined this tour up. So glad we did. Our guide, Carlos could not have been better! Our group ended up being 10 in all, & he was such an informative & fun guy. The places we visited were all marvelous, & he took very good care of us. You must do this tour! I hope you get Carlos!!

My husband and I had a great time at our Wine and Tapas Tour. The guide was knowledgeable, interesting and picked great wines and delicious tapas. We would do it again in a heartbeat! We were first time visitors to Madrid and had no problem finding the meeting place. Our guide spoke impeccable English and was very entertaining.

tour was a group of about 15 people from all over the world, guide was interactive and super, had a lot of great food and drinks we wouldnt have known to try otherwise as well as historical facts and advice on how to spend the rest of our time in the city. def recommend
We had a great time tasting delicious tapas and enjoying new friends from around the world! Highly recommend this activity!

Leticia our guide was bubbly and informative. She glided through several tapas bars with matching wines. The food and wine were great. She engaged everyone in the group making us all friend at the end of the evening. I highly recommend.

Muchos gracias for a wonderful tapas tour this evening. Carolyn we had a wonderful time. Our guide Leticia was so much fun to be with and we really enjoyed learning so many things with her:, Spanish history, Madrid history, Spanish wines, and Spanish Culture. We went to 4 bars to sample tapas and wine at each location, and it was all delicious. The tour lasts from 7:39 to about 11. And you will not leave hungry. Pace yourself- which is a challenge because the food and wine is excellent. One of the highlights was the dessert at the last bar near Plaza Mayor.

We came to Madrid and wanted to experience some nice Spanish food & wine and after reading the reviews on this tour we thought we’d give it a go.

Lovely backstreet pubs and restaurants you wouldn’t normally think to go in, amazing selection of foods and some of the best wine we’ve had.

Rodrigo made the tour as his English is amazing and he is very knowledgable with everything you want to know from history to food and wine.

Can’t recommend this tour enough, great price for a great night.
We had a great time, Carlos was very knowledgeable and fun! We had plenty of food and left very full. Wine was great as well. Overall, we really enjoyed the tour and would recommend. Worth the money!
I had a great time on this tour. Paula was wonderful and clearly loved showing people around her city. It was a great introduction to the city's food culture.

Paula was our tour guide and was friendly and knowledgeable. We visited 4 tapas bars and had a good range of 3 or 4 dishes in all but one - the exception being the speciality shrimp bar. The food was all tasty and included Spanish omelette, belly pork, padron peppers, shrimps in garlic and a chocoalate tapas to end. I enjoyed both the red and white wines.

The other people on the tour were all North Americans and very nice. We all chatted and had a good time.

Some of the dishes were shared between two rather than being individual portions which means sharing your plate with a stranger if you are not in a couple.

Paula took photographs during the evening to share via email with additional information. Unfortunately she missed my email address and my attempts to contact the company to rectify this have been unsuccessful.

Altogether it was a very enjoyable evening.

We had a great time. Our guide was very entertaining and informative. We also had a great group of other tourists that made it so much fun to interact throughout the night. From the tripe with garbanzo beans to the apple cider poured from a distance to the shark, it was a memorable experience. There are a LOT of tapas restaurants in the area. We had both typical and less typical food, and wine that most people would probably overlook. But it was all good.

Had a fantastic day on this tour. Tour guide was knowledgeable, friendly and professional. The bars were local and friendly. Food and wine were amazing and all local so you got a real feel for being in Madrid. Would highly recommend doing this tour.
The Topas Tour Rodrigo led was really amazing! Good and lots of Tapas, learned a lot of spanish coulture and normal life....appreciate your great Tour Rodrigo!!!!!

We had such a fantastic tour with our guide tasting the most fantastic tapas and wine at Madrid's hidden places, where we never had visit without this tour. We recommend all visitors to Madrid spending some hours with Gourmet Madrid Tours and experience the same as us.
Paula was amazing. Amazing food and amazing location. Everything was amazing. We were lucky to have a good crowd

Very good way to explore parts of Madrid and eat in various tapas restaurants that you would not have come across by yourself. Our tour guide was very passionate and great fun and provided excellent information on Madrid’s history and food.
Our first destination was hard to beat, so much so we attempted to eat there again the following night (unfortunately closed on sundays) but was very happy with our tour and food. The wine was well chosen also and complemented the food.
We also received great advice from tour guide on pintxo place to eat next day and was grateful for that.

If you are in Madrid do this tour, an absolute must!!! Carlos is an amazing guide, so informative about the city and the tapas. Garlic prawns and vermouth were the highlight. A great way to find hidden gems which you would never find on your own. Experience Madrid like a local!
What a wonderful tour and fantastic food. Mario was amazing and I highly recommend this tour if your in Madrid. Also met some great people as well.

Had a great time on this tour - I learned a lot about the local tapas and wine, and culture as well. The group was really fun to chat with, the food was delicious, and very interested stops. I was travelling alone for one evening, and this was a great way to spend the evening. I feel bad - I totally forgot our tour guides name though!! I'd recommend to anyone visiting Madrid.

This was a great night of fine wine and good food. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and friendly. It was great to go to the small tapas bars that where family owned I would recommend this tour if you are next in madrid
Carlos did a fine job introducing us to wines and tapas across the beautiful city of Madrid. The itinerary and variety was fantastic- highly recommended!

My friend and I decided to do this tour the day of and it was one of our favorite days in Madrid. Tour guide took great care of us and brought us all together as like we all knew each other before the tour. I left with everyone contact information afterwards. I would highly recommend!

We were in Madrid for a long weekend and thoroughly enjoyed this wine and Tapas tour. Our Guide Miguel was fun and informative about the history of Madrid he took us to 4 different places where we were given different a good selection of tapas to try, also accompanying wines were recommended which we enjoyed. we would definitely recommend this tour to anyone looking for a fun night out mixing with other people.

This tour was absolutely enjoyable, entertaining and satisfying for my husband and I. We didn’t know what to expect other than food and drinks but the history behind everything was an added bonus. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable of the wines and the best restaurant tapas locations.
We had only one night in Madrid and could not have spent it better. Food and wine were excellent and our guide Ismael was fabulous! You will not be disappointed nor will you leave hungry.

This was the best part of our trip to Spain!!! Our guide was fantastic! The small group setting was perfect. All the tapas places we went to were delicious and our guide was filled with knowledge and information about Madrid as well as each place we visited!! Saw places and tasted food I never would have found/tried had I not done this tour. Highly recommend this to anyone visiting Madrid!

Tour was well-organized and out guide, Carlos, was friendly and knowledgeable. We walked to four restaurants, a short distance between each. All had a different assortment of foods and wines, with a few surprises too. Tables were set up to facilitate easy conversations with other attendees. We left knowing a little history, food culture and with a few more friends.

We highly recommend this tour. Carlos was friendly and made the tour fun and informative. Our group was friendly and it was great company and great tapas. You get to try at least a dozen tapas (enough for dinner and a good variety of different foods) and 4 different wines (you also have the option of cava or vermouth at a couple of the stops).
Our party of 8 had a great time! Paula was wonderful, assuring everyone’s comfort. Tasted some nice wines and the tapas were plentiful and delicious . Highly recommend this tour!
Great guide and we lucked out with a wonderful group of fellow travelers. All the food was tasty especially the shrimp 🍤

I booked this on the spur of the moment since I was by myself for the evening and didn’t have dinner plans. Our host was wonderful and was full of knowledge about the food and wine of Spain and Madrid. He took our group around to several restaurants and introduced us to at least 3-4 different tapas in each one, including plenty of wines and beverages! I highly recommend this tour if you’re looking for something different for dinner while in Madrid. I promise you won’t leave hungry!

This was my husband and our first-ever tasting tour and we loved it. Our guide was very knowledgeable and knew so much about the food and each location we went too along with the wine that was paired with each tapa. I highly recommend this and it was also a great way to see a lot of Madrid as we went to 5 places all over the city. It is also a great way to meet other people and make some great connections.

This was the perfect evening out in Madrid, loads of amazing tapas and wine to taste alongside! Madrid has so many Tapas bars and options to choose from, this was a great way to sample some of the best on offer and choose the ones you wanted to return to! Paula, our guide, was very knowledgeable and made sure everyone had a lot of fun together.. even though we didn't know each other! Highly recommend this one..

This was one of the best tours I have ever taken. The guide was excellent the variety, quality and abundance of food and wine was superb. I highly recommend this tour.

.

Paula was the best guide:-) She was patient, kind, funny and explained all about the history of each locale and its' people. The food and wine selection in each restaurant was spot on and lovely. I love that there were a mix of old and new; fast-paced, fast food-like and family-style settings. I would definitely do this tour again and maybe even for longer, say the full day. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

In August 2018 my wife and I decided to give this tour a try, we had no clue what to expect. The tour ended up being the highlight of our trip and when the tour ended we spent the night drinking and hanging out with all the new friends we made on that tour!

That being said, when we returned to Madrid in 2019 with our daughter this tour was at the top of our list! Needless to say we were not disappointed and so happy to once again take this tour!

Our guide this time around was Paula. If you are lucky enough to get on her tour you will be very lucky. She will educate you on the history and traditions of Madrid while navigating you through delicious tapas and wines at 4 local taverns, all offering something just a little different than the others. She is friendly and engaging, willing to answer any questions and speaks perfect english. I cannot recommend this tour or Paula highly enough, as I said, this is our second time taking the tour. If your coming to Madrid do yourself a favor and check this out!

Fantastic tour with Carlos - would definitely recommend. We've done a few food tours and this was one of the best. Excellent variety of good - quantity and quality. Carlos was friendly and informative - it was great to learn more about the food and wine of Madrid.
Paula was an awesome guide as we tasted wine and tapas at 4 different stops!! Great group and lots of fun!!

Wow! We never expected to have such a great evening...the food, wine, tour guide and other people on tour were all amazing! Carlos did a super job guiding us through the tapas world of Madrid! We thoroughly enjoyed the entire tour!

We booked this evening tour for our first night in Madrid. Carlos was a super host and in a way the tour helped orientate us about the city quicker than anything else. Lovely group from all over the world.. we returned to casa del abuelo a couple of times later in the week for sneaky portions of gambas al ajillo!!! Mmmm 😀
Our tour guide was incredible - so knowledgeable, and obviously loved what she was doing. Paula is the best. The wine was great, and tapas were fantastic! Would definitely do again.

From the moment we met our small organised group, it was perfect. Our guide, Carlos, was cool calm and educated on all things from history to tapas to wines. A great way to spend a few hours. We visited authentic tapas bars, not typical tourist venues but authentic local places. He made it a wonderful experience and a strong highlight of our visit to Madrid. I would strongly recommend it to anyone. When we finished the tour, we stayed on with some of the people we had met and enjoyed some more cava and great fun. A memorable tour

My husband and I decided to sign up for this tapas and wine tour so that we could get a good sense of the variety of tapas available in Madrid. Paula Gil-Casares did a fabulous job of picking out a good mix of places for us to stop. She also ordered a nice variety of tapas and wine for us to try. When we were very satisfied with the experience and would recommend this if you are looking for an authentic Madrid tapas/wine experience.
What an excellent way to start our stay in Madrid! Fun, food, drinks, a knowledgeable guide and new friends! Seriously! Take this tour. You won't regret it.

Our guide Paula was punctual. She explained to the group on what to expect for the night. We were shown 4 different bars, each has it unique tapas and/or drinks. The tapas were tasty, especially the garlic prawn at casa del abuelo.

Had such a lovely fun evening. Paula was the perfect guide. A really good thing to do. We went back the following day to the first restaurant we visited for an evening meal. Had we not done this tour we would probably have not ventured into this area which turned out to be full of traditional bars and restaurants.

As I do every time I'm in Spain, I go on a Tapas and Wine tour. This year we had Paula Gil-Casares as our guide and she did not dissappoint us - we all had a wonderful time. We tasted a variety of wines - and being a wine guy, I asked a lot of questions and Paula took the time to discuss with me. I didn't know that Spain produced Cabernet Sauvignon!
Along with the wine, we went to four outstanding places for tapas. We got to taste some really great Spanish cuisine - not the standard food that most touristy places serve.
I would highly recommend taking this tour and hopefully you are lucky enough to have Paula as your host for what will be a great evening.

Oh my word, I was a bit dubious of the tour but it was Amazing. Paula was our tour guide where we were taken around 4 different establishments frequented by the locals so you knew the food would be authentic, as was the wine.
There was such a variety of Tapas and it was all superb and the flavors - stunning and complemented by each wine paring.
I was the awkward one who preferred the White and the rest of the group had Red and the wine was really good.
We even took our Daughter who is 9 years old and she had a great time too going into all these quaint restaurants.
Paula gave us all the historical knowledge of the area, wines and restaurants too - so a huge thanks to her for making the tour so interesting and so much fun.
This is definitely a must for any visit to Madrid - well worth it for a truly authentic experience (and such fun).

Went on this tour with my wife and were really pleased with everything. Carlos, our guide, was "first-class", nice, funny, knowledgeable about both the food and wine. Really enjoyed walking about the old town and visiting the different places. This is a tour definately to be recommended!!

This was our first trip to Madrid, so we booked this tour to acclimatise ourselves with the streets, bars, tapas, wine and people of Madrid. We were certainly not disappointed. The tour began from a central meeting point, when our excellent guide - Carlos - gave us a chance to make our introductions to the rest of the party (the maximum of 12). He then took us to four very individual and unique tapas/wine bars, each with their own specialities, where we tasted a vast range of delicious tapas - salted fish, honeyed pork, white bean cassoulet, cheeses, ham, asparagus and so on... A particular favourite amongst the group was a bar specialising in hot garlic prawns served with vermouth. Carlos was the perfect guide - he was warm and friendly, knowledgeable and keen to ensure we were all enjoying the experience. Very good value and the perfect way to start a visit to this beautiful city.

Also available Vegetarin Tapas for Vegan and Vegetarian ppl like me :)
Do try Spicy Potatoes
Wines are pretty reasonable . Buy a bottle than a glass of wine ;)

Booked as a last minute decision so we could experience more of Madrid and hopefully some unique aspects. Well, it did not disappoint. Carlos was good about helping navigate some dietary issues and took us to some very unique establishments and we ate some amazing foods along the way. One of the best excursions we have ever done.

My husband, myself and our adult children visited 4 wonderful restaurants in a quiet neighborhood of Madrid. At each restaurant we enjoyed 3 or 4 delicious tapas and wonderful Spanish wines. Our guide, Carlos was lots of fun, very knowledgable and more than willing to answer all of our questions! I would highly recommend this tour to anyone who loves good food & wine! It was a GREAT experience!

We enjoyed our wine and tapas tour. Enrique was well educated about wines and the wine regions of Spain. We visited 4 wine and tapas bars during the 3 hour tour. There were different wines and tapas at each bar and they were all delicious. The three hour time frame was perfect, not too rushed but also not too drawn out. A great way to spend our first evening in Madrid, meeting another couple and a solo traveler also from the States. Would recommend this tour and Enrique, our fabulous tour guide!

My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed the evening! Our guide, Carlos was wonderful and very knowledgeable about the food and wine. I would definitely recommend this tour! We had a lovely time with our group as well.

Carlos meet us in a local square not far from our Hotel (easy walking) where we met our group for the evening. His talks during the walk to each location were very informative and filled with local information that made us look forward to each stops wine and food, history that you would not know. Wine and food was plentiful and excellent at all four stops on this tour. Everyone in the group of 10 had a great experience and a lot of that had to do with Carlos and his great knowledge of the families history and the wine at each stop on the tour.
I would recommend this tour for anyone who wants an out of way wine & food experience in Madrid.
Bravo Carlos!!

I took this tour my first night in Madrid. We had a large group so we split into 2 smaller groups. I was traveling solo but my group was great. The guide was nice, knowledgeable , and made the evening so much fun. Highly recommend solo or with family/friends.

I highly recommend this tour. Our tour guide Paula, was amazing and full of knowledge about each Tapas Bar we went into. The food was amazing and the wine couldn't have been any better. Thank you Paula for a wonderful tour!

This was our first trip to Spain and doing this tour was the Perfect addition. Tour group was small and Carlos, our guide, was terrific!! He not only educated us on the Tapas and Wine pairings in 4 different locations but gave us history as well. Plaza de Santa Ana was where we met and then walked from there to places you might not find on your own. It was Delightful and go hungry.. I would highly recommend this to anyone!!
Had a wonderful time with Paula last night. Food was great and wine was also good. Would recommend this to anyone visiting.
Thank you for the amazing experience! Everything was great I had a blast! The places we visited were unique, I liked it so much that I had to go back and eat again the garlic shrimp:)

I’ve done several good tours throughout Europe over the last few years and this was definitely one of my favorite tours. Our tour guide Paula was fantastic and the food/wine sampled was great. Make sure you come hungry for this tour because there’s a lot of yummy food to be had.

I was traveling solo and most everyone were a couple so I didn’t know what to expect. The tour was exactly what I needed after several days on my own. I had such a great time with Paula and all the wonderful people I met during the tour!! I highly recommend this tour if you want to try some amazing tapas and wine and more importantly, meet great people while enjoying a nice gastronomic experience!!!
Great tour. Highly recommend doing this as early as you can if you are new to Madrid. Tour guide was brilliant
Great tour guide Paula, passionate & interesting, took the time to get to know everyone in the group. Quite expensive for what we had to eat & drink but a great introduction to Madrid

My wife and I enjoyed a great night with Carlos and our fellow Gourmet Madrid tourers. With such a huge choice of bars in Madrid it was great seeking out 4 of the best under Carlos’ guidance. The tour was well organised and around a relatively compact area meaning more time eating and drinking than walking. We went to some great places enjoying a great selection of wines and some really tasty bites to eat, at the end of the night we’d had 4 drinks and enough food to fill us up. Highly recommended!

My wife and I enjoyed this tour very much. We had booked the afternoon tour and were the only two. It was suggested that we would have more fun with the 5:30p tour but didn’t have time. Our guide was fantastic and very knowledgeable. He knew the area. It turned into a personal tour and it was worth it. Trust the guide with both wine and Tapas selections. We tried things that we would never have ordered on our own. We really were glad that we had this experience!

Having never been to Spain before, my husband and I really wanted to experience the food and culture so we booked this tour for our 1st night in Madrid.
We met up with our group and our guide Manfred and we set off on our tour.
Throughout the evening we went to 4 restaurants and had amazing local tapas with a glass of Spanish wine at each stop. It was a great introduction to the local cuisine. My favourite was the Gambas al ajillo (garlic shrimp). It was phenomenal.
Our guide was fantastic, explaining the history of the area and buildings as we passed them.
Meeting other travellers and exchanging stories coupled with the amazing night this tour provides makes for a very enjoyable and memorable evening. Don’t hesitate to book this tour, you won’t regret it.

While in Madrid we wanted to drink some wine and try tapas so we signed up for the tour. This was easily the best thing we did while we were in Madrid! It was so good that, when we return to Madrid next year, we are doing it again! Our tour was led by Carlos. Throughout the tour Carlos explains the history of the restaurants your visiting, explains where in Spain your wine comes from and answers all your questions. You will visit four different restaurants, try an assortment of different tapas and enjoy 4 glasses of wine ( thats a whole bottle, FYI) We also met several different travelers from different areas of the world. We all had so much fun together that we after the tour we bar hopped and all became facebook friends. This is a must do, no way around it. If your looking for a night out with some food and wine do yourself a favor and book this now!

We had a phenomenal time on this tour - probably one of our favorite activities while we were in Madrid on our honeymoon. Our guide was so thoughtful and knowledgeable - we learned a TON about the city, Spanish wine, tapas, social life, and even found our favorite place to eat. We seriously went back to one of the places - La Casa del Abuelo two more times. DEFINITELY start your trip with this tour - it sounds like it's long, but it's very worth it.

Manfred was an amazing tour guide! The bars had delicious wine and tapas selections! Make sure you go hungry because you definitely get a lot of food. You get what you paid for and much more. After all, memories are priceless!

My husband and I usually like to go on a food tour when we are vacation. This tour was amazing! I've been on tapas tastings in the past and we mostly got cold plain ones. This tour included four different stops with a large variety of restaurants (modern, traditional) and tapas. Our guide was very knowledgeable and fun!

I want to thank our tour guide for making this experience so amazing. She created the tour herself and decided where to take the group. She picked such a wonderful array of spots to give us a well rounded taste of Madrid. She was one of the best tour guides my husband and I have every had the pleasure of exploring with. We just loved everything about our tour!! Madrid is AMAZING!

What a fantastic experience! Went with my sister and we had a fabulous evening. You get a full glass of wine or soft drink in each of the four venues and lots of tapas to try in each. The specialities of each tapas "house". Carlos our guide explained the history of each venue and where each of the wines came from in Spain. Groups were small and we made some really good friends. When you take into account all of the food and drink available it represents excellent value for money. Thoroughly wonderful experience.

I got opinion this tour is designed for people doing the first steps in study the wine industry, system of categories of wines. Our guide Carlos was very friendly and active guy. Unfortunately, I was not able to get more detailed information about categories of Spanish wines and hallmarks main wine regions of Spain. However, I got a fun.
It's getting the feel of what a great gastronomic experience is in Spain! Wonderful tour guide! Getting into a country is not just seeing tourist spots, but learning what people eat and drink daily.

Our guide, Paula, was very engaging, giving us lots of info and bringing us to the best places. (We had a similar dish a week later in another place, and thought the one we had on the tour was much superior!) She also showed us some historical places making us appreciate Madrid more! Everyone had an unforgettable, fun night!

My husband and I did this on our final night in Madrid. Carlos was wonderful - he was able to take us to restaurants/bars that we otherwise might not have found. I loved hearing more about the wine and food we we're enjoying. I would highly recommend this tour.

We were greeted by a friendly Tour Guide by the name of Carlos at St. Ana Square. We were a small group of 5 and he got all 5 of us to introduce ourselves to each other right at the very beginning. The weather played spoilt sport that evening but that didn't hamper our tour much.
All the bars we attended that evening had a rich history and background.
Carlos' selection of Wines and Tapas at each place were very good. However at the last restaurant that we visited in the square, the Tapas tasted very average.
Certain reviews I had read prior to booking this particular tour stated that people returned with their stomachs full after all those Tapas.
My husband and I being decent eaters however felt otherwise.
All in all this tour was very worth it as it gives you a decent insight into the tapas and wine culture in Madrid.
I would recommend you do this tour on your first day in Madrid to give you a feel of how drinks and tapas go together and how to make the most of your gastronomical experience in Madrid.
Carlos was a great guide, fun and very knowledgeable. Thanks to him, we had a wonderful time.

We arrived on Friday for a 4 day city break and decided this might be a good way of getting our bearings. This is slightly more expensive than other tours but everything is included. We met our guide, Carlos at Santa Ana square on time. 11 people in the group, a mixture of couples and individuals travelling alone, from UK and USA.

After a brief ice breaker we were off. Carlos was excellent and gave us information on the tavern, the food and the wine. We went to places we would never have found on our own and had food and wine we wouldn't have ordered. The food and wine were excellent.

The group gelled really well and we spent time talking to everyone which was really nice, making it a very social evening.

We had a great time, tasting some fabulous Tapas and excellent wines. Carlos our guide was informative and humorous. Especially good to meet up with other likeminded people looking to enjoy a great night out. Looking forward to the email from Carlos telling us which wines we were drinking. Thoroughly recommended.

I fully enjoyed every second of my Madird Tapas and Wine tour and I would highly recommended to anyone doing a city trip in Madrid!
Our tour guide Enrique took us to some traditional restaurants where we sampled so many traditional tapas and paella together with the accompaning wine. He gave a good explanation about the different wine regions in Spain and the grape varieties and the final the wine produce, etc. We lfinished the tour feeling stuffed, a bit tipsy....but money well spent!

We arrived in Madrid and spotted this tour on TA and decided to give it a go and we are delighted that we acted so spontaneously. A fabulous tour from start to finish and a must for day 1 in Madrid. Such a great way to learn about the Tapa, vino and culture of Madrid. Enrique was an expert guide and friendly chap and certainly guided us perfectly. We met wonderful fellow travellers and carried into the wee hours with one of the couples. Amazing first night in Madrid facilitated by this tour and Enrique!

My husband and I had a great time exploring various tapas bars with Enrique last Sunday evening. We met up with the group near our hotel in Plaza Santa Ana and strolled from place to place. There's not a whole lot of walking involved so if you have any any kind of restrictions, no need to worry here about that. It was a small group too which was also nice because it allowed us to chat not only with our host but also with the other visitors. Each bar was unique and Enrique provided not only good food but also the history of the bar. Wine was provided at each stop. It was a great way to learn about such a popular cultural event in Spain.

Carlos took us and 5 others on a 4 hour walking tour of 4 unique local restaurants in Madrid. This tour was fabulous, we visited locations which are family run, in some cases for over 100 years! Carlos chose the Tapas and wine in each location, explained some history of Madrid and shared the origin of the wine and food dishes.
Our group was small and therefore it was easy to build relationships, so much so that we all stayed out together after the tour for several hours!

Highly recommended!

A great first night out in Madrid. You get a taste of the best the city has to offer.
Food and wine was a plenty.. Great value for money.

My wife and I enjoyed a great tour with Carlos last Sunday evening! Amongst a lively and entertaining group we sampled some fabulous tapas and wine and were provided with some great historical and cultural information, all delivered in an interesting and humorous fashion! We returned to two of the locations during our stay and would have to declare our favourite to be the garlic shrimp and vermouth combo - not to be missed!!
This tour was wonderful. Carlos was a great tour guide and full of facts and information about the wine and cuisine. We got to hit up local spots and try signature tapas. Definitely try this tour!!!

Paula took us to four very different tapas bars. We had 1-2 wines at each and the tapas just kept on coming. Paula is a gem; she knows her stuff and is a lot of fun to just hang out with as well! Our group was a nice mix of couples and family, and it was lovely getting to know everyone. I would absolutely do this again!

We were given this tour by our children - a better present could not be found!
Carlos, our guide was warm, welcoming and knew his bars & wines well! There was no sense of being rushed, just a great night with a group of diverse people, who, by the end of the night, were friends that we could have known for years instead of just a few hours!
Fabulous tapas & wines to match!

It was a great expeience with Enrique , a wonderful evening with great tapas and wines on a friday evening in Madrid. 4 places aged from 80 to 200 years , each one specializes in specific tapas and great wines. Enrique is amazing I LOVED IT SO MUCH !! great evening !!

Enrique met us and escorted us to 4 taverns, all with delicious tapas and wines. He was very well informed and provided a great overview of how Madridleans socialize and enjoy their food. There was only one other couple in our tour, so we received lots of personal attention. It was one of the high points of our time in Madrid.

Our group of 6 friends took this tour a couple nights ago. Tirimia(?) was our guide. She was very nice and social with our group, talking about herself and the literary history of the city. We had our fill of different tapas at 4 stops...definitely enough for a dinner. The wine pairings were all delicious, as well. This tour is good if you want a guide to expose you to many of the main tapas that Spanairds eat...we tried things we definitely would not have ordered ourselves. This tour probably isn't for anyone who wants a more overall tour of Madrid's architecture or history...there are other tours that provide that. It worked well for our group.

Carlos conducted a great tour. Lots of Noel she of Spanish wine regions and the places he took us were great. Excellent as an introduction to Madrid. We were just a few hours off the plane. Highly recommend.
Leticia was our fantastic guide for a wonderful evening tasting and drinking tapas in Madrid. She was super knowledgeable and fun- the best! Would highly recommend this tour.
Excellent guide and four great tapas bars with informative introduction to tapas and orientation in central Madrid. Places we would not have known to go to or what to order. Fabulous experience
We had a really live and vivid team. Our guide was even having hard time to get everyone's attention. This tour was really a great way to get connected with other people who might travel solo.

We had a fabulous time on this tour! Paula made it more fun- so enthusiastic, friendly and knowledgeable. It was a very cohesive group- mostly Americans thrilled to experience all that Madrid has to offer!
Amazing guide and fun group of people. It was very informative and laid back I loved every minute . The food was amazing!!
What a fun night, delicious and abundant food, great wines, it was great way to try local tapas and meet new people
Amazing food, wine, tour guide and company! The tour guide was an expert and gave a lot of great info about the food and wine. Will definitely recommend to friends!
The tour went to four locations and we had wine and plenty of food at each stop. Great tour and the tour guide was exceptional.

Noemi provided excellent information about Spain and its food and the restaurants she selected provided some truly delicious Tapas and Wine…and the Cava (champagne) at our last stop was excellent!

I highly recommend this tour!
Carlos took us to 4 very different tapas restaurants. Food was delicious as was the wine. We had a fun group with people from all over the world
Excellent food selections. It was a great way to get to know the city and food early in our trip. I highly recommend it. Paula was an excellent tour guide too.

I booked this tour for my work team including my boss as we were in Madrid on a Medical conference. Let me tell you that we had such an amazing and fun time on this tour that I highly recommend it to everyone visiting Madrid. It was fun, we learned a lot about the culture of the Madrilenos, food was great, drinks too and our tour guides Leticia and Noemi were so passionate about their job and showing us their culture that we loved it. Thank you so much to them and also to viator for make all accommodations possible to have this big group all together in a tour.
Excellent evening of wine and tapas visiting lovely local bars. Paula was very engaging and informative. We also met a great group of people.
We went to 4 different places, with different wines and tapas in each place. Plenty of food, great wines and a great tour guide with Carlos. Very enjoyable evening.
Great food and restaurants but guide's English was very difficult to understand. Enjoyed the food and tour overall.
Everything! Paola was enthusiastic, informative and paced our tour and tasting perfectly. A great time!
Great introduction to Spanish tapas and wine.our guide was fantastic. A food tour is a wonderful way to learn about a country’s cuture and traditions.
Excellent food and Paula was amazing and great company She explained about the city and history but did not throw to many facts at us Brilliant tour
Excellent tour with delicious food! Paula clearly knew the city quite well and I’d recommend the tour to anyone that wants get a feel for Madrid while enjoying a variety of great foods and wines.

Leticia was an excellent guide.
We had a wonderful time and did not leave the tour hungry like we have on tours in the past.

My husband and I consider ourselves ‘foodies’. This was an amazing tour. Alfonso brought us to small, authentic restaurants that tourists don’t always find. He introduced us to delicious tapas we would be unlikely to try otherwise. We were treated to a taste of the Real Madrid. And we learned a lot too. I highly recommend!

We had a wonderful experience with our host Paola. I had never done one of these types of tours before and didn’t know what to expect. Paola gave us such a personable and fun experience. We went to four unique bars and had very wonderful tapas. I would highly recommend.

We had the most enjoyable and informative afternoon. Our guide was displayed great knowledge of Madrid & Spain as well as wine. The venues for food & wine were excellent. Would highly recommend the experience!
Fun night with 9 other people, they were all from the US and RG fun. Paula our tour guide was funny and entertaining. Oh, and I won the trivia contest. Pay attention.
Great time! Size of group was good. Enjoyed the stops and host was awesome…friendly, enthusiastic, informative. Loved recommendations of wine choices. Would definitely recommend.

Fantastic guide! She was so knowledgeable and explained every wine and tapa in great detail. We even learned a little bit while walking around the city! We had a lovely time eating and drinking at our 4 stops! Would definitely recommend.
This was a really great tour and a nice experience introduction to the tapas in Madrid. Tour guide was knowledgeable and the food was excellent

I have been on this tour many times over the years, every time I have an overnight in Madrid. The latest experience was disappointing and not as informative as the past ones I have attended. What was different this time is that no information was provided about the wines at each place other than an occasional pointing to a region on a map. This tour has become a crawl, but no where near educational "wine-pairing," so don't expect to be more informed about wines or regions than when you started. In the past, more was shared about the type of wine served as well as a bit of history about the wineries producing the wine. When I mentioned lack of information to the guide, I was told I could take a photo of the label on the bottle. Tour was fun and tasty, but do not expect to learn anything about wines in Spain.

Great tour! Nacho was fantastic showing us to 4 restaurants and adding in history along the way. We had so much food, we were stuffed! You also get a wine or beer at each place. I would do this again!

My sister and I had an amazing time on this tour! We are both foodies and have worked in the wine and restaurant industry, so we were hesitant to book a “touristy” experience…but the tour, the restaurants, the food & drinks, the guide, our fellow travelers, and the overall value far exceeded our expectations! Our guide Paola was super friendly and informative - helping us understand the rich history and culture of Madrid in both Spanish & English. I highly recommend this tour for a fabulous and authentic tapas, wine, and historical experience!!
Noami was an amazing guide! Very knowledgeable about the wine, food, and the history. Definitely would recommend to someone traveling to Madrid and looking to experience traditional Spanish tapas!
The food was good and the drinks were great. In each place we sat as a group which was really nice. Guide's english was a little hard to understand.
It was good. Enjoyed the tour director but wished he would’ve shared even more history. The tapas were not anything great but enjoyed the wine.
We had a great time! We walked around the area and were able to enjoy good wine, good tapas and good people!

We had a great time going to small tapas places and learning their histories; places we never would have found on our own. Meeting fellow travelers from around the world was also a treat and our guide, Ishmael, was fantastic!

food and wine selection was excellent, the guide was friendly but not very enthusiastic about introducing it. overall a nice night out with interesting international travelers, but I would have expected more for the price.

Carlos, our guide was wonderful. He was so knowledgeable and shared so much information with us about the history of the area and restaurants. We had the opportunity to try several different wines and Tapas that we never would have done on our own. Everywhere he took us was excellent.

Visiting the wonderful tapas bars with amazing 🍲
Great host and very knowledgeable about the 🍷 met some lovely people
Marina was amazing, the way she combined the history of the different landmarks and the wines and tapas was beyond enchanting. Definitely something you can’t miss. Happy to return and repeat!
Great value, excellent food and wine! Had a great night! One of the best and informative tours I’ve been on! Thank you

We had a great time visiting some of Madrid’s finest tapas bars while seeing many of the beautiful sites along the way. The food and wines were delicious and Our guide was very knowledgeable of not only the locations but also the wines we tasted throughout out the night!
Noemi is a very knowledgeable and pleasant Madrid guide. Her detailed knowledge of the shops we visited, the food and specific wines made the tour very enjoyable.

We had so much fun on this small group tour trying tapas and wine at different local spots around the city! Our guide, Carlos was extremely knowledgeable about the restaurants, dishes and wines and you could tell he was well liked and respected by all of the staff and owners at each restaurant! He definitely had us trying food we normally wouldn’t have ordered but so glad that we got to try! We only had 2 days in Madrid but are so glad that we decided to do this tour.
Fantastic host, great places, great fun. Good selection of food and wines, Highly recommend! A ***********
Fantastic tour. Our guide Marina was a local and knew some cool places. The food, wine, cider and aperitifs were awesome. Highly recommend this tour
This was the perfect way to spend 3 hours on a beautiful evening in Madrid. Food was fun and plentiful and they were generous with the pours. Our guide was knowledgeable and engaging.
Carlos was an excellent guide! The wine, tapas, and cider were flowing! I highly recommend this tour. Meeting new people from all over the world is exciting, too!
Paula was fun and full of energy! We hit some great local spots that were well visited, but we rolled right in with plenty of room to sit and fast service. Do it, it was fun!
Great experience, bars, wine and food selection was excellent, our tour guide had great knowledge of Spanish wine. Highly recommended!!!
Carlos was cool. Very knowledgeable and great conversations. The four different venues were unique in their own way. I would definitely recommend
Our guide was very fun and knowledgeable. The different types of food mixed in with the historical facts of the area.
Tried a wide variety of tapas and wine, the tour was a great way to introduce some of the classic cuisine of Madrid, as well as some neat history lessons. Only wish it went on longer!
Noami identified all the wines by region. We had lots of choice tapas at four different bars. They made provision for my friend’s food allergies. It was great!
Really enjoyed the wines and tapas. We went to places we otherwise would not have gone to and sampled tapas we had not tried before. Our guide Manfred did a great job guiding us.

We bought this trip off the tripadvisor site. Our guide was great, the drinks were pretty good but apart from a couple of outstanding dishes the tapas were average and not all they were built up to be in the description on tripadvisor.

We were left questioning whether the experience was good value for money..
Mariana was an excellent guide! We were thrilled to learn more about the history of Madrid, but also to experience a wide variety of tapas. Thank you Mariana!

The tapas and wine were great but the people, both fellow tourists and our awesome guide, were the highlight. Every stop brought a memorable experience and a taste of Madrid. Don't second guess, book now for a great time.
We had a great time on the tapas and wine tour. Our guide Marina was wonderful! She knew the best tapas spots and the history of Madrid. I recommend this tour!
Very knowledgeable guide, excellent venues with good food and wine. Had a great evening and highly recommend the event.
All the other people we met, the food was amazing and the wine was too, our tour guide was very knowledgeable of the area and the history of the venues
The tour guide Alberto was really knowledgable and good fun. The tour took us to restaurants we would never have seen otherwise. Totally recommend.
We enjoyed our tour guide. We explored some of the best areas to have wine and tapas, decent stroll around the area. My wife and I enjoyed the tour. We recommend.
Great experience. The guide was very friendly and knowledgeable. The restaurants were great to experience the Madrid culture
Really awesome way to see the city and try new foods and wines that you may not have otherwise tried! Highly recommend to any first time Madrid visitors.
Ismael was a fantastic tour guide. Friendly and knowledgeable. Took us to several great spots for delicious tapas and drinks! We are so happy we booked this tour.
This was a lovely experience. The people who were in the group were fabulous. The tour guide was great. The booze was really good. And the Tapas was a lovely selection. Would highly recommend to all.

Great tour and a guide who has a true passion for wine. Carlos was very engaged with the group and made it so much fun.
Selected restaurants that we have visited have been very interesting true gems!

Guide was great and she made it so fun! It was the best way to start our trip!!
She promised a email with pictures and discription of tour and have not received anything!
The food and wine were excellent. Our guide Carlos, was friendly, knowledgeable and passionate. Really well organised tour, totally recommend, but do not eat beforehand!

We had a great time on this tour. I recommend it to anyone. We made friends with the other travelers in the group - exchanged tips and information about our trips. There were 3 solo travelers in our group - what a great idea for connecting with other people while traveling alone. The food and wine in each place was great. Our tour guide Christina was fun and knowledgeable - she definitely gave us good information and recommendations. I was skeptical of the other reviews that mentioned this - but we also had so much fun we continued the night with most of our group and went to a few more bars after the official tour ended. I will book a tour like this in any new city we visit.
I highly recommend this tour. We stopped at 4 different tapas bars and sampled delicious foods and wine. Out tour director, Paula was wonderful!

Manfred was friendly and very knowledgeable about the places we visited and the food he introduced us to. Despite a small wait for all the guests to join us at the start, he remained focused on the task in hand. We thoroughly enjoyed our tour with him and had great fun with him and the other guests. We even returned to some of the establishments later on to continue to enjoy their delicious offerings. This is the third food tour we have booked through Viator and they have all been a superb way to get to know the city, history and food culture of the country you are visiting. Highly recommended. Can’t wait until we book the next tour! Thanks again Manfred!
Paula was a fabulous tour guide. Energetic and full of great information, both about the wine and food, but also the history of Madrid.

Absolutely loved the tour with Paula, lovely host, very friendly, incredible food (especially the garlic prawns) and some additional small historical facts too. She also explains well that each place is family-owned and a little bit of info there too
Highly recommended. Tour guide Carlos was super nice. He took us to great tapas bars. All the food and wine were really good. I really enjoyed the tour.
I had a great time. I went by myself and I felt part of the group and Carlos was great he explained to us the wine regions and some of the history of the restaurants visited. I definitely recommend.
Our guide, Natalya, was wonderful, offered us great information about Spanish wines and traditional tapas. The food was better at some places than others, the shrimp in garlic butter was exceptional.
Great way to experience Spanish wine and tapas with people from all over (Netherlands and Ireland). We had a great time and would do again in a heartbeat!

Brilliant evening, great fun. Well worth the money.
Lots of food in each place and a choice of wines. Stop thinking about it and book it!!
Amazing experience definitely a must do. Even the history lesson that goes along with it. Any questions do t hesitate to ask.
Raul was the perfect host. Very knowledgeable about food and wine. Passionate about Spanish culture. The group hit it off so well that 5 of us continued on well into the evening. A very fun night.

Raul was amazing with his combined knowledge and humour.
A very enjoyable evening and worth every penny

Carlos us a great tour guide. Highly recommend this experience.
Good times to be had by all. Food, drinks, and lots of laughs!
Ismael was an amazing guide. Totally made the trip worth it. Would highly recommend him for any wine tasting or food pairings.
Never done anything like this before and I was a solo traveller , both the host and the group in general were great. Food delicious and wonderful wine. Loved every minute
We had a lovely evening . Carlos was a very informative guide . We visited some lovely locations . The wine was delicious as was the food . I would thoroughly recommend it
Carlos was a great tour guide and showed us amazing spots and dishes madrileño style. The restaurants were great and the ambience was even better.
Very nice places, good tapas and delicious wines! We loved this walking trip through Madrid very much!
A great way to experience some of the oldest tapas bars in Madrid. A well presented evening with the tour guide providing a good but simple history of each location
Carlos was a wonderful guide. We really enjoyed hearing the history of the neighborhood he shared with us as well as his knowledge of the food and wine we were sampling. Thanks Carlos!
A wonderful evening! The tapas and wines were delicious and varied. Our guide, Paula, was very knowledgeable and charismatic. We lucked out and got to go with a good group of other tourists, as well.

Arrived at the meeting point just on time, traffic was so bad ended up getting out of the taxi and walking the last 500m.
The guide sort of introduced herself and told as a little about the area, then we marched off to the first bar.
Bar was absolutely packed and we were squashed around a small table. Two tapas and half a glass of wine.
On to location two, again a packed location, another half glass of wine and some nice tapas, on to location three.
The guide led our group of nine through packed streets, and we were separated. Over half of the group, including ourselves tried to call on the emergency number given, even sending our location, but later found out that this was not our guides number and no person answered. Not good!
We eventually joined up and went to the third location. A very small packed bar, no table to sit at, just standing shoulder to shoulder with other people. The tour was now running late we were told.
One full glass of wine here! Nice tapa (1) prawns and garlic. We’re rushed out of here to location four.
The final bar/restaurant was the best. A table to sit at, with some room. Half a glass of wine from Madrid, nice!Nice tapas, several choices and now time to chat as a group.
Some of us ended up buying drinks for the rest of the group too.
I have given the tour three stars, mainly because of the other people that were in the group, they were so nice and a pleasure to be with.
We went on to another bar to finish the evening, chat and swap numbers.
I felt the tour was very rushed, the locations were too busy, to a point that we were crammed in or split up.
The group should not have got separated and the emergency phone number was useless, in a time when it needed to work.
For the cost of this tour (€75pp) I felt the small glasses and one glass of wine at a venue was rather mean, especially as wine in Spain is not expensive.
Tapas were nice, but not plentiful. The tour was too rushed, probably the reason we were separated in the crowds, which made us even more late.
Had it not been for the wonderful people we met on this tour, I would have given this a poor report.
I think that possibility a large contributory factor was the unusual warm weather bringing people out for the evening, which made everywhere busy, this started with our taxi getting stuck in traffic. So, possibly a lot of my negative comments were down to this and so unavoidable.
Any social distancing was impossible!

This tour was amazing!! Booked it last minute and had the best time! It felt like the perfect amount of time and we loved getting little history lessons throughout the tour as we walked from place to place. Everything from the wine, to the tapas, to the friendliness truly made this experience one to remember!
Very enjoyable. Lovely tour guide, Natalia: she was very knowledgeable and engaging. I met some fun, interesting people. I would recommend!

The wine and Tapas Tour with Raul was spectacular! We enjoyed the wines and the food and the company. The little restaurants were so cute and accommodating. My son is a vegetarian and they went out of their way to accomodate.
What a fantastic evening! Great food, great wine and great company. Carlos was a impeccable guide and an all round nice guy. Very fairly prices and would highly recommend

It’s the first time I’ve did this kind of tour and would thoroughly recommend
Carlos the tour guide was very knowledgeable and good company
The food and wine were first class, well worth doing
The tour with Paula was fantastic. A must-do!!! This is a late review, I was there in 2019 and wanted to share how much my group and I appreciated this fun and delicious tour.
Overall great experience with my family. Delicious tapas and wine along with history of Madrid. Definitely recommend.

Our group was so diverse and so much fun! We met people from all over and had great conversation! Time flew by us but we were in great company. The drinks and tapas were great and we loved our tour guides recommendations! Definitely recommend doing this!

Carlos was very knowledgeable and spoke good English. He was happy to answer all our questions and explained the food and wine very well! He made all of us feel welcome and kept the pace going on time but not rushed.
Carlos was terrific, selecting great places and a variety of plates. He is warm and friendly as well as knowledgeable. Someone you would choose to hang out with.

Great group, great guide (Paula) great food! 12 tapas and a beverage at each of the four locations. We did a similar tour in barlecona a few weeks ago and had so much fun that we knew we had to take the same tour when we returned to Spain! We have gone back to one of the places we went two more times while in Madrid! (El Fontan) Also, our one of other tour guides recommended another place we had visited ok this tour as well.

Everything was perfect!. We enjoyed the food, the wines, the nice places we went to. Our guide, Carlos, is very nice and professionnal. The people we met was very plaisants and friendly. We have had an excellent evening and we recommend it!
Great food and well guided.. the places we visited and the variety of foods was wonderful. Lots of options and good wine.
Paola was amazing. The restaurants, the wine, and the whole night was awesome. It was great getting to know some fellow travelers from all over

Very personable, great introduction to the tapas vibe of Madrid.
Great information on wines and regions.
Fun 3+ hours mingling
We had an amazing time with lots of people from different countries and with Paula who was super nice and makes the extra effort to make everyone happy and welcome! Highly recommended!

The best tour we did during the entirety of our trip! Carlos was amazing and we even stayed out with our group after the tour was finished. The food and wine was amazing and you also get tons of information on the way from the history of Spain, the different wine regions and more! Highly recommend.

Our guide, Paula, has a very good English (has travelled quite a bit herself) .. she took us around the Center of Madrid, telling us a bit about the area, the history, the bars, the wine and the taps - very enjoyable! :-)
Had a great time, we had a nice group and ate some really delicious tapas and some very nice accompanying wines. Would highly recommend
Carlos did an excellent job on the tour. He was knowledgeable and passionate about the wine, tapas, and surrounding area. The wines that he chose were great. I would highly recommend!
Carlos did an amazing job with wine selections and tapas selections. He explained the regions and types of grapes for the wines and selected the perfect tapas that each stop was known for
Our guided tour with Paula was such an amazing way to taste Madrid. She is crazy knowledgeable and so friendly, I felt like I was out with friends. Would go again in a heartbeat!
Very good expérience with Paula guide, it's was very interesting. The wine and the tapas was very good
Carlos was awesome. He explained a lot about Spanish wine regions. We saw some interesting restaurants we would have missed. The group was fun and engaged.
My girlfriend and I had a wonderful tour that well surpassed our already high expectations. As the title says, amazing tour, amazing guide!
Very good food and wine. The staff were so friendly and helpful, but very professional. I would recommend this restaurant
A great night, with great food and wine. Made by the guide and of course the other people attending!
Really good food and wine. I would definitely recommend you take this tour if you like tapas and drinking wine.
We really enjoyed our evening with Paula. She was enthusiastic and knowledgeable. The tapas and wine were delicious. It was a great introduction to Madrid. I highly recommend it.

Paula was wonderful! Her warm personality was perfectly suited to give me a tour of the history of Spain and Madrid as well as the wines and tapas we had. It felt like I was going out for tapas with an old friend!

Paula did an amazing job guiding us through the streets of Madrid! The restaurants she chose were all family owned and had amazing history... tapas as well! It was definitely the highlight of our trip and can’t wait to be back.

if you really want to take a good wine and tapas tour, this one should be it! It was our 3 night on Madrid, a Saturday night and it was the best activity we have done so far. It’s fun, tasty and interesting! Full recommended!

Great experience. Rodrigo, our guide, was fun and full of information. The tapas were delicious and plentiful, and the wines were varied and different from what I’d had. A truly enjoyable experience, Give yourself a treat and take the tour.

My friend and I booked this tour during our first day in Madrid expecting to try great food and orient ourselves to the city. What we got was so much more! Our tour guide, Paula, was amazing! She took us to the best spots and really knew her stuff. I learned so much about Spanish cuisine, the history of Madrid, and, most importantly, wine. I have never been much of a wine person but Paula converted me. I highly recommend taking this tour while in Madrid.

The wine and tapas tour was excellent. We visited 4 local tapas bars and the progression of the type of tapas was well thought out. Paula, our tour guide, did an excellent job with explaining the history of the area we walked through and the history of each of the bars we visited.

I would highly recommend this tour!
Best Viator Tour I've Done! Our guide was fantastic and made sure everyone's needs were met and that we all had a good time. I would do it again if I had more time in Madrid!
A first class evening and our eleven year old son was well looked after a shame we had to get him back to the hotel for some sleep!

We had so much fun learning about the wines and what region they came from, drinking the wine and eating some delicious local delicacies. Paula was a blast and made the experience even better with her knowledge and positive energy.

This was Our 1st trip to Madrid and we wanted to get familiar with the city. This walking topis and wine tour turned out to be just what we needed. Our guide was very informative and introduced us to some of the back street local fairs. Definitely recommend it.

This tour is a must when visiting Madrid. Paula, our guide for the evening took us to 4 different places to taste wine and eat tapas. She also gave us information on the different types of wine we were tasting, as well as the different regions of Spain that produce wine. The food and the wine were both really good and there was a good mixture of people from different parts of the world to get to know and interact with. This was really fun because these were the types of places tourists normally wouldn't know about to go to so we got to dine like locals while we were on vacation in Madrid.

If you are looking to try famous tapas in Madrid this is the tour for you ! We went to 4 different places and they were all amazing. Our tour guide was so sweet and very informative. We loved every minute of it.
Booked this at JFK just before boarding for Madrid. Less than 24 hours later took the tour with eight others- great fun, food and drink. Highly recommend!
Carlos was an excellent guide. He took us to really great authentic tapas. He was very kind and patient when our group of all new friends were getting along a little too well. Thank you!

Came to Madrid with my family wanted to experience the culture and food. Would highly recommend this as part of your trip. A night to remember Thank your for the great wine and food. Guide was informative with great personality.
Great company, people on the tour and WeMadrid! 😉 Laura, our guide was friendly and knowledgeable. Worth it.

Carlos had pesonality and gaves us plenty of information during our 3+ hour excursion. The 4 restaurants were fantastic choices. We didn't expect so much food and one glass of wine and more per stop, which was plenty to keep us going. The garlic shrimp at our one stop was incredible! We met people from other countries and easily joined the various conversations. Our new group of 7 stayed at our last stop and shared a bottle of vino and more conversation, exchanged emails, #, etc...THX CARLOS for a memorable evening;D

Carlos was our guide and he was very knowledgeable. Took us to some great places that we went back to after our tour to purchase some of the wines. We definitely had plenty of food and we loved seeing the side of Madrid off from all the tourists and learning about some of the history. Recommend.
Our guide Paula was excellent, all of the food and wine was amazing. She also did a great job giving details on historical locations/facts along the way.

Mario was our guide and made the entire tour. Knowledgeable about so many intricate details regarding the city and wine connoisseur. This guy killed it and highly recommend it if you get him leading the way. So happy we did this.

Jeff & Britt
Nice guide, great experience with a group of friends or strangers! Not too much walking, stayed in a localized area, good food and wine selections with information on them as well. Highly recommend.

The tour was amazing! And Paola was awesome! Super informative and very outgoing! My husband and I were on our honeymoon and our friend purchases the tickets for this tour as a gift and it was wonderful!

This was an afternoon of delightful company, food and wine. I couldn’t recommend this any higher. It was informative, fun and delicious. If you’re debating what to do for an afternoon, look no more! You will not regret it.

We were part of a group of around twelve folks. Carlos, our guide was colorful and engaging. We went to four different venues, while being provided with something different at each stop. He also gave us a lot of additional background as we walked from venue to venue. It was a stellar way to spend the evening.

What an excellent way to learn about the City of Madrid with rich history. Bonus is tasting tapas as you move from location to location. Our group was catered for by providing non alcohol drinks and water at each stop. You will have a full belly by the end of the evening. Our guide ‘Leila’ was the best!!! Highly recommended. We are from New Zealand

This was a great tour with very good tapas and excellent sangria. My favorite was the last stop where we had violet ice cream! Even though it says wine tour they were very accommodating and allowed beer and sangria as well. Mario was an excellent guide and very friendly and knowledgeable.

This event was an amazing value. The food and spirits were all enjoyable. The group was diverse, interactive and a pleasure. The only sometimes drawback is that some of us had difficulty at times understanding the guide’s English. He was knowledgeable and provided a very interesting narrative.
Great tour guide with lots of knowledge, food, drinks and venues visited were excellent. Would recommend

Overall, an amazing experience. We walked, laughed, learned the history of the individual restaurants and the city, ate great food and had delicious drinks. Are guide, Enrique was top notch. He went above and beyond to give us a fantastic experience and even made sure we had places to go after the tour was done. I wish we would have taken the tour earlier in our trip but better late than never. The best way to see some of the city.

Carlos was everything you want in a tour guide: fun, knowledgeable, personable & efficient. We visited 4 tapas restaurants. At each restaurant, we had our choice of beverage. Usually red or white wine, but one restaurant added a cava choice, one included a sample of cider in addition to the wine (you got both) & another added a choice of vermouth & a sweeter red wine. There were several tapas plates for us at each restaurant. It was more food than the group of us could eat. Definitely the highlight of our trip to Madrid!

Our guide, Phula, was excellent. She was informative, friendly, well-organised and made the evening a wonderful experience. The bars she took us to were good tapas bars and the drinks were good too. I highly recommend this tour.

We had such a fantastic time today with Carlos tasting the most delicious tapas and wines at Madrid’s hidden gems. So many spots we wouldn’t have had the courage to pop into as first time visitors to Madrid.

Paula Gil-Casares was a GREAT guide for our group of about 10. She took us to 4 different taverns where we had a nice variety of wine and tapas. I highly recommend doing this; in addition to the local flavors and local history, you’ll have fun chatting with other folks on vacation too. Thanks to Paula!
The tour is amazing in that you get to go to all family owned bars and local places to get a real locals POV of the restaurants

We stayed for 3 nights in Madrid and fell in love with the city. We pre-booked the walking Tapas and Wine Tasting tour for our first (Friday) night and we were not disappointed!
4 stops for delicious tapas and generous serves of great wine. Amazing value for money. Our tour guide Paula Gil-Casares was informative but such good fun! She ensured everyone had the best night. We went back to 1 place the next evening, just wish we had more time to revisit the rest.
Highly recommend as a very informal introduction to the city, helped us get our bearings (& a great dinner with vinos) on our first evening.
Thanks Paula!!

The Wine and Tapas tour with Carlos was such a fun experience. The group size was perfect (about 10 people) and allowed everyone to get to know each other. Carlos was really knowledgeable and passionate about wine in general but especially in Spain, and he hand picked excellent tapas for the group along the way. He made it such a smooth and delicious experience for all of us. We even went back to one of the stops the next night to indulge in more tapas! Put this tour on your list of things to do when you get to Madrid
We had a great night, tapas was lovely with plenty of variety and lots of wine. We were in a group of around 20 who were all very friendly. Tour guide was excellent. I would definitely recommend.
Really enjoyed the evening, great guide, delicious food and wine and excellent company. Highly recommend!

I was worried I would be the only one who had booked this tour given it was a monday night, but there were at least 20 of us which made for a great evening. The tour guide welcomed us and gave lots of useful information about the restaurants, the food and wine. The tapas were amazing - belly pork, gambas in garlic butter, tostas with aubergine & many more. Fantastic evening - highly recommended.
Some of the tapas were shared by 4 people instead of couples. Charge moire if there is a budget for tapas, etc.

Well worth it! Carlos, our tour guide, was excellent. He really knows what he is talking about and educated us on Spain's regional wines and the history of Tapas.
