He seems really passionate about what he is talking about. He was very interested in what each individual thought about the foods and wine we all tasted. Make sure to ask for Carlos.

Our Madrid Tapas and Wine Tasting Tour was an excellent introduction to the sumptuous Spanish food and wine scene. The bars selected were outstanding, the food and wine selections were first rate, and the descriptions and discussions were interesting. Carlos, our tour guide, was intelligent, insightful, and friendly; he was perfect. We highly recommend this tour and Carlos.

I am so glad we booked this tour. The guide was fabulous, the wines and tapas were excellent, and the tour was in part like one of the walking tours of the area, including a lot of information about the area in which we walked The walking was not arduous, our fellow travellers were genial--it was a superb way to spend an early afternoon!

Our guide for this tour was Carlos, and he was wonderful. The restaurant stops were perfectly timed, and the food & wine were great. We stopped at many “hidden gems” that we would not have found on our own. We even ended up going back to one of the stops on the tour for dinner that night. Carlos was pleasant and vibrant - it was obvious that he genuinely enjoys the local wine and cuisine and we were glad to have him share his knowledge with us!
Really and outstanding tour of some of the lesser known tapas restaurants and winery bars. Our guide, Carlos spoke great English and was very informative.

We were 4 couples travelling together and stayed in Madrid for three nights. This was our best evening and we really enjoyed the tour.
Carlos was a great guide and he took us to places we would provbably not have visited on our own. I highly recommend it!
This was a great experience! Raul was very knowledge and a great guide! The group was great and easy to converse with. I would recommend this tour to anyone. The food was great and so was the wine!
The highlight of our two week European adventure. The best way to experience Madrid’s Centro. Raúl is great!
Even with torrential rain,the tour was awesome! Ismael did an amazing job at keeping the group entertained and educated. I would do the tour again if I had more time!

The tapas bars included on this tour were fun, historical and the food was good. The wine was better than I expected and the walking wasn’t that far or difficult.
Our guide Pablo had a bit of an attitude which is why I didn’t give it an excellent rating.
Make friends with some of the others in your group and it will be a fun evening.
Definitely a highlight of our visit to Madrid. Our guide Carlos was very knowledgeable and entertaining. Delicious tapas and wine. A great way to explore the city and meet new people!

This was a fantastic food and wine tour. The food was fantastic and very generous portions. There were various wine selections including various red, whites, sparkling, and even vermouth and cider. Our guide was very nice and informative. Definitely recommend this tour.

This was a fun way to experience traditional Spanish tapas and lovely wine. Our tour guide was very informative and engaging with everyone, a really nice guy! We got to taste some delicious food and meet some wonderful people. Definitely a must when you visit Madrid!

The wine and Tapas tour was outstanding. Our guide Carlos did a wonderful job. We got the history of each place then he selected a white and a red wine along with 2-4 Tapas at each place. The 4 places were very different and specialized in different things so we got a great cross section of tapas and wines to try. I highly recommend this tour. Great value for the money spent!

We had the best night with Paula! Definitely the highlight of our Madrid stay. The tapas st each bar was fantastic. There was so much food we could barely eat it all. Paula was extremely knowledgeable about the wines and she worked hard to meet everyone’s needs! We highly recommend this tour!

A must do tour! We did this tour on our first night and it was the best thing we could have done on our first day. We had the best tour guide! He was knowledgeable and funny. We met some great people on our tour, and will definitely be one to remember. Highly, highly recommend.

What a fantastic experience! This unique wine/tapas tasting tour was highly enjoyable: starting off with our guide, Paula, who met us promptly at the meeting point; to the lessons about grapes and wine; to the types of tapas we were trying; to the places we visited... all of it was a great way to explore some of Madrid. Paula's knowledge, enthusiasm, professionalism, kindness and absolutely amazing engagement with everyone to make everyone feel included was ideal. She also included a little history lesson about the area which was really interesting. The locations for the wine tasting and tapas felt very authentic and people in our group were very friendly. I'd definitely recommend this tour and Paula!

Knowledgeable and friendly guide takes you on a tour around a couple tapas places which you probably wouldn't find on your own. A little bit of history behind each place and each meal. Don't worry what to choose - the guide picks the best tapa each place has to offer, giving recommendations for drinks (which you then pick yourselves). Nice variety of food, don't worry about having to try the same thing twice. Great experience!

Our guide Carlos was knowledgeable and really nice. The wine and food(garlic prawns!!) was really good and plentiful. The best thing about this tour was meeting all the new people you would probably never meet and chat with otherwise. Our group was very diverse from three continents with age spanning from 18 to 60(?). Some of us continued the evening together. Very recommended!

Easy to book, well organised, guide excellent, good value for money.
Great way to experience local tapas in Madrid
We had a wonderful time and Carlos was a great host. Highly recommend. We went to several restaurants and had wonderful tapas and wine. Fun evening!
Our guide was Carlos and he was amazing. He explained the regions, history, and culture of what we had.
This was an excellent occasion to not only try traditional Spanish cuisine and wine, but also to meet fun people from around the world that were visiting Madrid. Highly recommended!
Wonderful experience. Food, drink, city history tidbits all fabulous! Our guide provided good drink recommendations and ordered yummy tapas at each of our stops.

My husband and I recently joined a small group and our host, Carlos, for a wine and tapas tour around Madrid. This was such a fun way to explore some local establishments. We visited four tapas bars and had different wine and tapas at each. Carlos was excellent at explaining the food, drinks, and what made each location special. We had so much fun.

Our guide Enrique was amazing and very knowledgeable. All the food and wine was delicious and it was fun to get to know others visiting Madrid. We learned a lot and went to places with a lot of history. Definitely would recommend!

Love these tours. You not only get to taste great food and wine like a local, but you learn about the local customs and history at the same time. Give yourself plenty of. Time to find the meeting point. It can be confusing and you might make a few wrong turns along the way!
4 old and interesting bars, good food and wine, great group of people and a knowledgeable guide perfect formula for a fantastic night. Highly recommended

This was probably the best food tour we’ve been on during our travels. Each stop was different and Paula, our outstanding guide, took the time to explain the different wines and tapas. The food was abundant and delicious (that garlic shrimp was to die for and so nicely paired with the sweet port), and we made many new friends. In fact, after Paula said goodbye, most of our group went back to one of the stops on the tour for more wine. Thank you Paula for such a great evening!
An experience not to be missed, so much to see and taste, excellent wines and lovely food, should have taken longer

Just loved this experience. Our group bonded really well together, the food and wine experience was fabulous, and our tour leader was very knowledgeable and friendly
I would do it again in a minute!!
Only had one night and the tapas tour was the best choice. Had a great time, guide was great and met some new people... and yesterday the food was awesome!!!

We had a fabulous evening with people from all over the world. That, along with the terrific food and wine would have made for a fine time, but we had Paula as our tour guide, and her enthusiasm, expertise, and wicked sense of humor made it one of the best times of our trip. This was a great time.
We had a very ambitious tour guide - Paula - and got a lot of Information about wine, Tapas and Spanish culture within this three hours. Very advísable!

A very nice welcome activity after a long and tiring flight. Paola brought us to restaurants and provided us with the context and history of each place. The choice of food and wine gave a sample of what lies ahead in the coming days. Paola had very good command of English.
A must activity!

We met some really fun people on our tour and Paula was a terrific host. The local bar/tapas places were excellent and we ended up going back another night to a couple. Great experience if you enjoy meeting new people from other countries. We all went out together after the tour ended and had so much fun.

The best way to try four of the most interesting tapas bars in Madrid— do this before relying on a tour book! Our guide, Ismael, is a native of the city and a winemaker. In addition to teaching us about the various wines and wine making regions of the country, he told us about the origins of the delicious things we ate. I’m a pescatarian (no meat, except for fish) and a non-drinker, but there was so much food — including delectable gambas, queso, and verduras— that no one went away hungry. You’ll meet friendly people, too! A wonderful experience, not to be missed.

We visited four different Tapas bars that we wouldn't have found of independently. The food and wine were really good and the people we met were really good company, especially as the evening went on. Our guide, Paula was excellent, really knowledgeable and friendly and she made the evening for us. It gave us a taste for tapas for the rest of our visit to Madrid.
Loved this tour. We had Wine and Tapas from 4 different places. By the third restaurant our group bonded and we were feeling nice. Out tour guide was great!

What a great way to get local flavor! We visited four different places for wine and tapas. Each one was different; but, in every case, well worth the visit. The food and drink at all were delicious. Our guide, Carlos, did a great job, explaining what all the dishes were and from what region each wine came from. Carlos made our evening enjoyable and a lot of fun. We highly recommend the tour.

The Tour Operator was Native Spanish Tapas and our guide was Pablo.
What a great trip! We met in the Plaza de Isabel 11 at 7pm. It was a small group of 12 and Pablo took around the centre of the city and told us about many of the historical sites. We called at a restaurant where we tasted Cod Croquettes and red wine. Later on the tour we stopped again to be served with ham and cheese tapas and a choice of red wine or beer. Along the way we saw many streets bustling with tourists and many outdoor eating places. Our final destination was a lovely small restaurant where the table was set for 12. There was as much Sangria and water as we wanted. The meal started with Gazpacho soup, served cold in glasses. That was followed by Spanish Omelette, which was absolutely delicious and pieces of sausage in garlic sauce. The main course was a superb Paella. There was more than enough for everyone. Second helpings were very popular. The evening finished with a choice of liqueurs including grappa. At the end of the evening which was around 10 30pm, Pablo saw all his guests out pointing them in the direction of their accommodation. A great evening. Thank you Pablo.
It was easy walking
Really enjoyed tour. Good selection of Tapas and lovely wines. My husband was catered for with plenty of beer. Guide friendly and helpful. Would recommend taking this trip.
Highly recommended!!! We fell inlove with Madrid and its wine and food. The tour was incredible and showed us the little spots we would have never seen on our own. A must try!

Not knowing Madrid well, this group provided an excellent start to vacation..their knowledge of the local food and wine was perfect and the group was great..absolutely loved the garlic shrimp..highly recommend..

Carlos was excellent guide and included much about the history of the area.
My wife loved tasting the vermouth and the wine and food was great.

Did the wine and tapas tour with my husband and two college-aged children. The tour exceeded all my expectations! Our guide, Argos, was amazing. He was so friendly, knowledgeable and personable. He made the experience so enjoyable! We tasted great wines at every stop and had multiple tapas options. I was worried my daughter and I wouldn’t like any of the tapas because we don’t eat meat. Instead, we had so many things to try at each restaurant. Carlos made sure there were tapas for everyone to sample. We were stuffed by the end of the night. I would do this tour again if I come back to Madrid.

Best fun. Great food. Great selections. Wonderful tour guide Thomas. Went out of his way to be sure there was a non meat selection at each stop for me. Different wines and ciders and beers. Whatever we wanted. 4 hours + of fun night. We wore out the college kids on the tour. Became pricey but only because we asked for it. Would recommend to all.

Paula was a wonderful guide, this was our first day and it was a fabulous way to spend an afternoon, great to learn about Spain’s history as well as taste and enjoy the real local family-run tapas restaurants of Madrid.
This tour was delicious and very informative! Paola did a great job and took us to some really great places! Highly recommend.

Paula was so much fun and guided us to the best tapas and wine restaurants in Old Madrid! The food and wine that she hand picked were perfect together. She took great pictures of our 8 person group at every stop and sent them to us the next day...I adore her and would go on any tour in which she was involved. We also had a perfect weather day in Madrid and want to back for at least a week (we were only there for 3 days this 1st trip).

As a flight attendant with a gazillion layovers in Madrid, I decided to try a food tour since I love food and have been disappointed in the past in the city.
Food tours give history as you walk from place to place as well as an insight into the food.
What I didn’t expect was the fun factor.
This equals a 5 star review,even tho I have decided Spanish food is not even close to France or Italy.. I will look forward to another tour with his company and have already informed my colleagues what they are missing.
Small group wine and Tapas tour Paula was excellent guide. And fun. Good food and good wine. Plus meeting new friends. Highly recommend.

Highly recommendable Tapas and Wine Tasting Tour, especially for beginners. Besides learing a lot about the history of Madrid, you learn "how to do tapas" in a very enjoyable way. Afterwards, we got the idea of becoming "new Madrileños". Additionally, we discovered certain tapa-like food, that we shall prepare at home, too.

Carlos was great at leading the tour and wonderful food and wine choices. He also took time to explain some of the culture and background in the small area we visited in Madrid. Would definitely recommend!

This was the only tour we pre-booked, and I'm so glad we did! Enrique, our guide, was absolutely amazing and so friendly. Our group felt like friends after our tour. It was a small group and so much fun. We returned to one of the tapas restaurants a few days later and bought several bottles of olive oil as gifts. The food, the wines and the general vibe were just great. Do yourself a favor and book this tour!
Paula was a fantastic tour guide. Excellent wines and tapas. Lots of fun people on the tour. Highly recommended!

Paula was a wonderful tour guide. She was so informative, fun, and engaging. Paula took us to great tapa places and provided us with just the right amount of history and background on the places and neighborhoods. She had great positive energy and a great personality. Top tour guide we had on our trip. Bravo Paula!

Could not have had a more relaxed stroll around Madrid with a great diversified group tasting wine and experiencing the local Tapas. The wine was great and the guide shared with us each region where the wine was from as well as other information about the wine. Paula also shared with us the overall history of the locations and the buildings with in our tour area. For me the shrimp was the best, but overall a on a scale from 1-10 the tour was a 9++. I will be telling my friends who visit Madrid to look into this one.

This tour was so fun! Everything we tried was amazing, and Carlos was an excellent guide. This is a great choice if it is your first time in Spain and you are unsure where to eat. We did this for dinner one night and it was great.

We had the best time walking through the city enjoying wine and tapas at wonderful small restaurants. Our guide was fantastic. We enjoyed the wine and tapas so much that we found ourselves going back to a few of the restaurants the next evening.
The experience was an excellent mix of food, wine, locations, education and personal interactions. We would highly recommend this tour to others.

Good pit stop after arriving. Carlos and 12 of us visited 4 sites and 4 wines to drink.
Second place authentic old tapas place with my favourite tapas - a stew. Final visit to one of the oldest restaurants in town. I cannot remember most of the food but remember the wines which were good. And the people - a great crowd. Recommend.

We toured 4 tapas restaurants and were delighted with the selection of both the tapas and the wine. There were vegetarians, pescetarians and others with food restrictions, and all our needs were met. Our guide, Enrique, was so personable and funny and he showed us a great time. He was able to give us some of the history of the restaurants as well as providing us with a very educated lesson in wine tasting. It was one of the best things we did in Madrid!

Great group of people and a fantastic guide made a fun night. Learned a great deal about food and wine which we will certainly use in our remains weeks in Spain. Paul was wonderful in weaving the histories of the food, wine, Madrid, and Spain.

Paola was our guide on a beautiful night in Madrid. She was knowledgeable and fun. The wine and food delicious. Enjoyed our group as well! Highly recommend! Be aware that there was a full glass of wine or drink at all stops-not just a tasting!!!

The tour was a great success. While visiting 4 different locations with serveral Tapas and a glass of wine (choice of different kinds) each time we got information about the locations we were at and the history of them. We had a very diverse group but we all got along very well and even after the tour we all stayed to have a few drinks together.

This was my 2nd tapas/wine tour in Madrid...enjoyed it so much the first time, I thought it would be a great experience to do it again. Our Tour Guide was Carlos who was not only very knowledgeable but took the time to explain each and every tapa and wine presented during the tour. He allowed enough time to truly experience the atmosphere if each of the places and it was great to know we were not being taken to the high traffic tourist places...these were truly the local variety. Carlos made sure we were taken care of and made each of the tour group feel value added. Totally recommend this tour and if possible, have Carlos as your guide. It was a blast!!!!

Carlos was personable, spoke excellent English and looked after us very well. The group was 3 couples, one Brits, 2 USA but from opposite sides of the country and a good atmosphere quickly formed. We were offered a good range of food and wine, taking into account one person's need to avoid seafood, and the venues were all characterful. A tour of the old brick winecellars and bottle store at one place was enjoyable. This was our 1st night in Madrid and was an excellent way to get orientated and be inducted into the tapas habit.
So much fun! Delicious tapas, outstanding wine (and wine education), and a convivial group of tasters. Our guide Enrique was knowledgeable and full of interesting stories.

Great tour and a very nice guide, Enrique! He was just on time, took us to very authentic places and told a lot of interesting facts about Spain culture, food and wines. We really enjoyed it and had amazing time on this tour. Tapas and wines were extremely delicious. :)
Fabulous tour with a great guide around a beautiful and vibrant city. Food & drink were all delicious

We had 1 day in Madrid and this was a great way to experience the local flavors! This tour I highly recommend!
Louis was our tour guide and he was beyond wonderful. So much information given on wines and the establishments. We were in a party of 12 and Louis made us feel like one big family. Please don’t miss this tour when visiting Madrid. So much variety of Tapas to try. If wine is not your thing, is ok to order beer or whatever you would like.

We joined a group of five for this tour which consists of stops at 4 restaurants/tapas bars. At each location , we experienced 2-3 tapas dishes and a glass of wine. Carlos was the perfect guide —— very personable and knowledgeable. He made it a point to interact with everyone in the group and engage the group in discussions of the wine and tapas.
The one improvement to this tour was we tasted only a total of four wines—— it would have been a better experience to at least taste two wines side by side even in smaller portions
Enrique was our tour guide and he was great! Great food, awesome wine and met some friends that we will continue to do activities with throughout our trip in Spain! Would highly recommend!

What a delightful evening! Our guide Luis was terrific tour guide as we wound our way through the streets of Madrid. Each Tapas bar was a new experience for us along with the history of the area. The selection of food at each one of the bars was delicious and the wines accompanying each visit exposed us to a good variety. The group enjoyed the evening and exploring the local neighborhood and the Tapas bars. Terrific tour!

We really enjoyed this evening treat. Food and wine (and vermouth) was excellent. Lots of information and tour guide was very informative. Not too big a group as not to be involved, lovely range of people. Some couples and some single travellers.
A great food tour. Ended up feeling like we'd spent an evening with new friends over great food and wine. Highly recommended.

Once we booked the tour, we prompty received all necessary information concerning location to meet in Madrid, duration of tour, cancellation policy etc. The meeting place was within walking distance of our apartment rental, as was the end point. Our guide, Enrique was so knowledgable and passionate about wines of Spain and the history of Madrid which made for a wonderful evening of wine tasting and tapas. Because of his experience and enthusiasm as a tour guide we were able to explore wonderful well established (some up to a hundred years old)hidden bars where we had the chance to try a varied selection of tapas not ordinarily offered in most tapas bars, as well as fine wines from all over Spain. I would highly recommend this wine tour to everyone who visits Madrid and wants to become more immersed in the culture of this wonderful city. We were so fortunate to have Enrique as our guide for the evening.

A great way to explore tapas and wine in Madrid. Our host Paula offered us a great assortment of both. We were a group of 3 couples and we were joined by 2 other couples for a tour of 10. Everyone was friendly and we toured 4 bars which included La Casa del Abuelo, El Lacon and Restaurante Taberna Parilla. See how Madrid comes alive at night!

Our host was the energetic and enthusiastic Paula! We visited four really individual bars/restaurants in the old part of Madrid and enjoyed lots of generous tapas tastes at each along with some selected wines. There were 11 in our tour and we all got along fine, enjoying some banter along the way with each other. I did my best to help out those who couldn't manage all of their wine samples, it was tough, but someone had to! Thanks to the ladies from Hawaii!

Our guide Paula was energetic and fun. Her English was very good. She had selected 4 bars within a block or 2 of our meeting point. We enjoyed several plates and a wine at each location. Paula explained each wine and what we were eating. She also pointed out some points of interest along the way. Fun, fun, fun, best tour yet!

Last night we took the Madrid Tapas & Wine Tasting evening tour with our guide Paola. Beautiful evening to take a leisurely 3 hour food & historical walking tour. We met at the Plaza de Santa Ana and visited 4 tapas bars - tasty tapas & wine at each stop. We made numerous historical stops at plazas and buildings between bar visits. The wine at each bar was from different Spanish wine regions and were all delicious. There were multiple tapas dishes at each stop and our bellies were satisfied by the end of the tour. I also had a delicious vermouth at our last stop. Paola was fun and a pleasure to spend 3 hours of learning and eating thru a Madrid neighborhood. I’d recommend both this tour and Paola.

My husband and I did this wonderful tour of tapas places in central Madrid. Our guide, Carlos, was very knowledgeable and informative as well as making the evening good fun. All the places we stopped at were different and very good. We had a great evening and would definitely recommend this tour.

Carlos was a great host/guide as we tasted wine and tapas at 4 bars. Subsequent to the tour he emailed the group details of the wines and portions we tasted. I would recommend doing this on your first night in Madrid.

We did a tapas walking tour with 11 other folks from the US, UK, New Zealand and Mexico. Our guide Manfred took us to 4 tapas bars in three hours. We were served one plate of tapas after another paired with Manfred's recommended drinks 😀. Manfred did a fantastic job explaining the food and wine we were getting. He took time to answer our individual questions. It was certainly a gastronomically satisfying experience (we left the group VERY full), made even more memorable by the fun group of people who were with us.

We had an amazing time with Carlos on the tapas and wine tour. We learned a lot about different tapas options, wine, and tried some interesting new foods. Everyone in the group was so lovely and nice, and Carlos always made sure we enjoyed ourselves and the food.

If you’re going to Madrid, you definitely want to go on this tapas tour. Best ever!!!

This tour had been recommended. It did not disappoint. Our guide was great. Really interesting and informative but great fun! Make some lovely people and the wine and tapas were good value too. Thank you Manfred.
Great tour that included a variety of tapas and lovely wine. The tour allowed us to discover great places to visit again during our holiday

My wife and I had a blast on this tour and met great people!!! Our guide, Manfred, was awesome!! He was extremely knowledgeable, very friendly, and taught us a lot about Madrid and traditional Spanish tapas! The four tapas spots we visited were excellent, offering a unique variety of selections with very good wine pairings. The walking part of the tour was a great way to explore the city as well. We highly recommend this tour!

This tour was probably the gastronomic highlight of our stay in Madrid. Prior to our visit to Spain I had heard of, but never tried, Tapas because I could never get an answer to exactly what they were. This trip cleared the "mystique" and gave us the confidence to go out several times while we were there to try some of the huge range of tapas available. The matching wines offered on the tour were of excellent quality and were an education on the range and quality of Spanish wines available from different regions of Spain.

If we were to return to Madrid this would be high on my list of priorities to do again.

It was an exceptionally good tour and well worth the cost. I would highly recommend the Wine and Tapas (or was it Tapas and Wine) tour to anyone looking for a fun evening out combined with a true taste of Spain.
We went on August 6th with Carlos as our guide. He was warm, friendly and knowledgeable. He took us to 4 great places and everything we had was delicious. This is a fun thing to do in Madrid!

Paula is an exceptional guide being friendly, lively, vivacious, intelligent, and knowledgeable. I’d definitely attend a like tour again, especially if Paula is the guide!! Oh yah, the wines drunk and tapas eaten were superb!!

This is one of the most memorable moments of our trip! Carlos was fantastic as he took us to restaurants we never would have tried on our own. There were only six in our group from Croatia, London and Ecuador, so we were able to get to know one another while sharing fabulous, large portions of food and wine. Definite must do. The Garlic Shrimp prepared in front of us at La Casa Del Abuelo were seriously the best shrimp we have ever had!

Fantastic tour. Enrique was an amazing guide, very knowledgeable and made the evening an interesting experience.

The wine and tapas choices exceptional, great group of people , a lovely enjoyable evening
Anna

My girlfriend and I were only in Madrid for the weekend and we booked 2 tours with Gourmet Madrid Tours (the other was a wine tour). BOTH experiences were fantastic and we would do both again. This tour was especially great for us as we felt that it provided a real feel for both local cuisine and food culture. At each stop there would be 4-5 things to try paired with wine. Paula was our guide and she was as knowledgeable as she was fun and pleasant. It was very well organized.

A Great introduction to a beautiful city. And, a Fun time with other tourists. Carlos did an Amazing job - culture, food, wine & cool places we wouldn’t have found- we went back the next day finding new & old places!

As a last minute decision, I signed up for the Tapas and Wine tour of Madrid...and had the best time! Paula was our guide and she had a group of strangers talking casually with one another by the time we reached the first bar. From there the night continued to get better and better! Paula expertly described the city of Madrid as we walked, along with the long histories of the family owned establishments we visited, and the types of Tapas and the wine regions of Spain were discussed...and tasted! This was the perfect tour to introduce me to Madrid and still leave me longing for more.

I had a one-day stop in Madrid and I chose this tour - it was absolutely awesome and our guide, Carlos, was super friendly and knowledgable. We got to go to places that I'd probably have never selected on my own and I feel like I got to see the "real Madrid."

Come hungry - the food and wine samples are very generous!

After meeting up with our group we set of with Enrique through a few tapas bars in Madrid. The different bars we visited all had their own flair and foods. The explanations we got from our guide were all on the topics of the different wines and food, but also about the history of Madrid and tapas bars.
The food and wines we got were all amazing and worth the tour.
What made the tour for us though was the people we met, mostly Americans and a couple from Korea. After the tour was over, our guide stayed a little longer to share some more of his knowledge about Spain and also take part in some discussions. After he left, our group stayed for some more discussing and chatting for almost an hour. Very happy we took this tour!
Excellent tour, presented expertly by Paula. She made the tour extremely fun and also shared lots of the history surrounding madrid. Highly recommended.

We had a fantastic experience on the tapas and wine tour - lots of amazing food (we left very full!) and drinks. Manfred was a brilliant guide - friendly, knowledgeable and made it a very fun evening. We very highly recommend this tour.
Great experience and really enjoyed the food and wine . We met lovely people from USA, London and Ireland. Our tour guide Enrique was fabulous and very informative.
We had an excellent time with Carlos and the other guests. Very informative and the Tapas and wine were very tasty!!

Carlos was an awesome guide. We went to some great places and had great food and wine. It’s a fun way to see the restaurant area of the city and way more efficient than trying to do it on your own. Do it the first night you get there to get a feel for the area. Then you can go back to what you like.
Carlos led an informative tour that took us to wonderful tapas bars that we probably wouldn't have found on our own and ordered delicious tapas that we wouldn't have known to order.

This tour brought us to places we would have never gone nor found. We tried food we would not have normally ordered which was great and Carlo our guide was great and moved us along so we didn’t get bored. It was nice to meet some English speaking friends during this time and share the experience. We will do it again in other cities for sure.

The other month I took the Tapas & wines tour with Enrique.It was a chili evening but soon enough the warm personality of the guide whom I can describe in one word - Charming, made the evening an awesome one. Enrique has a vast knowledge in the wine world and the tour was very tasty and educative.It really opened a window to a new array of tastes and grapes for me. Highly recommended.

Me and my friend from Sweden went for this wine and tapas tour on Monday evening.
Carlos was our guide! What a fun and super nice guy! Perfect English!
Two wonderful couple from the states joined too and they were hilarious.
Had an amazing night with super good wine, fantastic tapas and learned about history in Madrid.
Many laughter and much joy!

Went for a wine and tapas tour with Paula - it was an amazing experience. She made us all so comfortable. Paula took us to sample four tapas restaurants and I am still missing the garlic shrimp with the locally made sweet wine from Alicante! We even had the opportunity to sample Torrijas which is a dessert made during Easter! Paula explained all the food and wine we had on the trip and even sent us an email with a list of what we ate and drank (including some photos she took of us during the tour). There is no better way of ending a great evening than with this tour.

Went for a Wine and Tapas tour on a Saturday evening. Our guide was a wonderful and interesting lady - Paula. A great experience! So much fun!!!! Great food and incredible wine. Wish I could do every night!!!!

I really enjoyed the tapas tour. Our guide was very friendly and took us to several local tapas restaurants we wouldn't have come across on our own! The first one was more or less average, but the other three were amazing. As we progressed through the evening, people in the group started to open up more and more, making it a very social experience.
The guide was excellent, he told stories about the places and food, and answered every question the group had. Also the wine and tapas were delicious.

We had an excellent group. Carlos our guide was superb. His knowledge was excellent and he was always keen to listen and help.
i would recommend the tapas bars to anyone. the wine was really well chosen and went perfectly with the food.
If you like wine and tapas a must do tour. Thank you Carlos.

This was our very first tapas and wine tasting tour which we embarked on the very first day we landed in Madrid, and needless to say, we had an amazing experience. We were fortunate enough to have a group of pretty awesome folks to share the experience with, and Carlos our guide, was absolutely fantastic! Carlos took us to the best spots in town and the food as well as the drinks far exceeded our expectations, and we made a great dinner out of it. Would highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants to embark on an unforgettable experience and enjoy great food, wine, and company!

We were two couples and had the best time with Paula in Madrid.
She took us to great tapas bars and we had a lot to eat and of course excellent wine too.
Paula took us to places that we never dreamed to visit. Moreover, Paula provides us with lots of information.
Paula id great and we highly recommend.

This wine and tapas tour took us to 4 family owned bars in old Madrid.
The lovely old buildings and the atmosphere in all of them was amazing.
Lively, noisy and very Spanish.
The matching of food and wine, with care to cater for individual tastes as necessary was very well done.
Best of all was our lovely, energetic, humorous hostess, Paula.
A really great night out.
